title: Robotics and IOT Trainee
description:
**Position: Robotics & IoT Trainee**

**Employment Type: Traineeship**

**Work Location: Pune – Work from Office**

**Eligible Candidates: Mechatronics, Electronics & Telecommunication (E&TC), Robotics, and related engineering students/freshers**

**Compensation Structure**

**• Stipend (Probation Period – 6 Months): ₹10,000 per month**

**• Post-Probation Salary (Next 12 Months): ₹20,000 per month**

**• After 18 Months: ₹3.4 – ₹5.4 LPA (Based on the performance during 18 months)**

**• Note: Mandatory 18-month contract Agreement**

**About the Role :**

We are looking for enthusiastic and curious engineering trainees interested in Robotics, LiDAR, IoT, Drone Technology, Digital Twins, and Research & Development. The trainee will work with the engineering team on developing, testing, integrating, and researching technology-driven solutions for real-world applications. This role is suitable for students and fresh graduates from Mechatronics and E&TC backgrounds who want hands-on exposure to robotics systems, sensor integration, IoT devices, LiDAR technology, automation, and emerging engineering innovations.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Assist in the development, testing, and integration of robotic systems and autonomous platforms.

• Work with
**LiDAR sensors, cameras, GPS/GNSS, IMU**
, and other sensor technologies for data collection and processing.

• Assist in integrating sensors, microcontrollers, and electronic components with robotics and IoT systems. • Work on IoT-based solutions, including sensor connectivity, real-time data acquisition, device communication, and monitoring.

• Support
**drone-based data collection,**
sensor integration, and autonomous system experiments.

• Assist in developing and
**testing Digital Twin**
and simulation environments for physical assets, robotic systems, and infrastructure.

• Conduct research on robotics, LiDAR, IoT, autonomous systems, and emerging engineering technologies. • Explore and evaluate new hardware, sensors, software tools, and technologies for potential product applications.

• Assist in robotics programming, hardware-software integration, and troubleshooting.

• Work on sensor data processing, visualization, mapping, and basic automation.

• Support experiments related to
**3D mapping, point cloud processing, object detection**
, and environmental perception.

• Assist in testing robotic prototypes and conducting field trials.

• Collaborate with Software,
**AI/ML, Computer Vision**
, and Engineering teams to develop integrated solutions.

• Prepare research reports, technical documentation, experiment results, and project presentations.

• Stay updated with developments in robotics, LiDAR, IoT, drones, and automation technologies.

**Required Skills**

• Basic understanding of Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, and Control Systems.

• Basic programming knowledge in Python and/or C/C++.

• Understanding of electronic circuits, sensors, actuators, and microcontrollers.

• Familiarity with platforms such as
**Arduino, ESP32, or Raspberry Pi.**

• Basic understanding of IoT concepts, communication protocols, and sensor interfacing.

• Interest in
**LiDAR technology,**
point clouds,
**3D mapping, and sensor-based applications**
.

• Basic knowledge of robotics, automation, and autonomous navigation.

• Familiarity with communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, MQTT, or TCP/IP is an advantage.

• Understanding of data collection, analysis, and technical research.

• Familiarity with
**ROS/ROS2, Gazebo, CAD tools**
, or simulation software is an added advantage.

• Willingness to learn new technologies and work on practical engineering problems.

**Educational Qualifications**

• Diploma, Bachelor's degree, or currently pursuing engineering in:

o Mechatronics Engineering

o Electronics & Telecommunication (E&TC) Engineering

o Robotics Engineering

o Electronics Engineering

o Electrical Engineering

o Instrumentation and Control Engineering

o or a related technical discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

• Academic or personal projects involving robotics, IoT, sensors, or automation.

• Exposure to LiDAR sensors, point cloud data, or 3D mapping.

• Experience with Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, or similar development boards.

• Participation in robotics competitions, technical clubs, or research projects.

• Familiarity with drones, Digital Twin concepts, computer vision, or embedded systems.

• Basic knowledge of research methodology, technical documentation, and experimental testing

**Key Competencies**

• Strong interest in research, innovation, and emerging technologies.

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

• Practical approach to hardware testing and troubleshooting.

• Willingness to learn through experiments and hands-on project work.

• Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

• Attention to detail and good technical documentation skills.

• Flexibility to participate in laboratory testing and field deployment activities.

**Learning Opportunities**
During the traineeship, candidates will gain practical exposure to:

• Robotics system development and sensor integration.

• LiDAR-based sensing, point cloud processing, and 3D mapping.

• IoT devices, embedded systems, and real-time data acquisition.

• Drone technologies and autonomous systems.

• Digital Twin and simulation technologies.

• Technical research, prototyping, testing, and product development.

How to apply: If you are genuinely interested for the role then send your resume on
**hr@aiunika.com**

title: Data Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Data Architect to lead the design, modernization, and governance of enterprise-scale data platforms and architectures. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in data engineering, cloud data ecosystems, enterprise integration, analytics, AI/ML data readiness, and modern data governance practices.
  
  
The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, AI teams, engineering teams, and leadership to build scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions that support digital transformation and advanced analytics initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and implement enterprise-wide data architecture strategies, standards, and best practices.
* Design scalable data platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, and modern lakehouse architectures.
* Lead architecture discussions for cloud-based data ecosystems across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Design end-to-end data pipelines for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
* Establish data governance, metadata management, lineage, security, and compliance frameworks.
* Work closely with AI/ML teams to enable high-quality data foundations for analytics and AI solutions.
* Define enterprise data models, master data management (MDM), and data integration strategies.
* Guide teams on ETL/ELT frameworks, streaming architectures, and real-time data processing.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Lead performance optimization, scalability planning, and cost optimization initiatives for data platforms.
* Evaluate and recommend new tools, technologies, and accelerators in the data and AI ecosystem.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to data engineers, developers, and architects.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Participate in solution estimation, proposal creation, architecture reviews, and customer discussions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or related field.
* Cloud certifications preferred:

+ AWS Certified Data Analytics
+ Azure Data Engineer / Solutions Architect
+ Google Professional Data Engineer

* TOGAF or enterprise architecture certifications are an added advantage.

**Technical Skills**
**Essential skills**

* Strong experience in enterprise data architecture and large-scale data platform implementation.
* Expertise in cloud platforms such as:

+ AWS (Redshift, Glue, EMR, Athena, S3)
+ Azure (Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, ADLS)
+ GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc)

* Strong knowledge of:

+ Data Warehousing
+ Data Lakes / Lakehouse Architecture
+ ETL / ELT frameworks
+ Data Modeling
+ Data Governance
+ Master Data Management
+ Metadata Management

* Experience with modern data engineering tools such as:

+ Databricks
+ Snowflake
+ Kafka
+ Spark
+ Airflow
+ dbt

* Strong SQL and database design expertise.
* Understanding of AI/ML data pipelines and analytics ecosystems.
* Experience with API integrations and enterprise integration patterns.
* Familiarity with DevOps/DataOps/MLOps practices.

**Leadership & Functional Skills**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience leading distributed/global teams.
* Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
* Ability to drive architecture governance and technical decision-making.

**Experience**
10 years +

title: Technical Trainer
description:
**Company Description:**

C4i4 Lab, backed by the Ministry of Heavy Industries, India, is focused on accelerating business transformation through Industry 4.0 and digitally enabled smart manufacturing. The organization supports companies in adopting technologies such as IoT, AI, Big Data Analytics, and Robotics to enhance productivity, agility, and real-time decision-making. Its holistic approach spans people, processes, and technology, helping organizations achieve manufacturing excellence and operational flexibility. C4i4 Lab offers digital maturity assessments, immersive model factory and iFactory network experiences, and technology and skill enablement through its i4Skills platform. It also builds industry ecosystems, interfaces with government stakeholders, and collaborates with academia to deliver comprehensive skilling and immersion programs.

**Role Description**

C4i4 Lab, Pune is looking for a
**AI/ML Business Applications Trainer**
**/ Faculty**

to prepare students and industry professionals for the future of smart manufacturing and connected industrial systems. This role exists to bring Industry 4.0 technologies into classrooms and training programs through hands-on laboratory training and project-based learning. Working on deputation at academic institutions and industry client sites, you will help learners understand how physical systems, embedded computing and networks come together in real industrial applications. In doing so, you will directly support C4i4 Lab' mission of bridging academia and industry.

**Qualifications :**

**(Must-Haves)**

**•**
Education: Postgraduate degree (M.E./M.Tech./M.Sc./MBA or equivalent) in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Business Analytics, or related

disciplines.

• Ph.D. (pursuing or completed); exposure to Industry 4.0 applications, smart manufacturing, AI/ML, or applied research.

•
Programming & Technical Skills: Proficiency in Python and familiarity with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.

•
AI/ML Fundamentals: Working knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, clustering, model evaluation, feature engineering, and basic predictive analytics.

• Soft Skills: Strong communication, presentation, mentoring and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and run interactive sessions for academic and industry audiences.

**(Nice-to-Haves) :**

• Experience: Prior teaching, corporate or technical training, research or laboratory instruction experience is encouraged, along with practical experience in AI/ML.

**Core Responsibilities & Duties**

• Hands-on Lab Experience: Experience developing practical notebooks, working with datasets, conducting demonstrations, implementing end-to-end ML workflows, and troubleshooting student lab exercises.

•
Business Application Expertise: Ability to connect AI/ML techniques with business problems such as forecasting, customer analytics, operational efficiency, risk analysis, quality prediction, and decision support.

• Data Visualization & Business Tools: Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools will be an advantage.

• Project Development: Experience in guiding or implementing applied AI/ML projects using real-world datasets will be highly valued.

• Develop curricula, course materials, laboratory manuals and project-based learning modulesaligned with emerging AI/ML technologies.

• Conduct practical assessments, evaluate learner projects and mentor participants.

• Support the deployment and demonstration of AI/ML technologies and laboratory infrastructure at partner institutions and industry sites.

• Collaborate with faculty, industry clients and subject experts to bridge theory and industrial practice, including customized corporate training.

or client location; permanent work from home is not offered. Travel within India and internationally for
  
  
client engagements and conferences is required.

title: AI Platform Applications Engineer/Associate Director
description:
**Ready to scale enterprise Generative AI products from prototype to production?**
**Why join us?**
HSBC Productivity Suite is our AI-powered workspace used by 250,000 colleagues across the bank. We’re moving beyond conversational generative AI to build intelligent agents and integrations that connect colleagues with trusted enterprise knowledge, services and workflows.
  
  
You’ll join a global engineering team solving complex problems at significant scale. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how artificial intelligence is designed, governed and used across HSBC, with real influence over architecture, engineering standards and product direction.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Our team consists of around 50 engineers across the UK, India, Poland and China. We’re growing our engineering capability in China and are looking for an experienced engineer to work as a senior technical contributor within one of our engineering pods.
  
  
As an Associate Director, Software Engineering, you’ll operate as an individual contributor, designing and delivering significant capabilities for HSBC Productivity Suite. You’ll take complex requirements from initial definition through coding, testing, release and production operation.
  
  
This is not a formal people-management role. You’ll spend most of your time on hands-on engineering while providing practical technical direction, removing delivery blockers and mentoring other engineers in the pod.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
This role will carry out the following activities:
  
  

* 10+years of Min experience.
* Spend most of your time on hands-on engineering, writing, reviewing, testing and shipping production code for HSBC Productivity Suite.
* Design and deliver significant generative AI capabilities and integrations, owning delivery from requirements through to production operation.
* Act as a senior engineer within an engineering pod, making sound design decisions, clarifying ambiguity and breaking complex requirements into actionable deliveries.
* Build secure, resilient and maintainable services, applying appropriate engineering controls across testing, deployment, monitoring, observability and production support.
* Use and improve shared frameworks, platforms and reusable capabilities, giving constructive feedback and reducing duplication and technical debt.
* Promote effective engineering practices, including the safe use of AI coding tools and agents to improve quality and delivery across the software development lifecycle.
* Take an active role in production incidents, helping restore service, leading reviews and ensuring lessons result in practical improvements.
* Mentor engineers through pairing, design and code reviews, knowledge-sharing and practical support, while informing technical direction through evidence and engineering expertise.

**What you’ll need to succeed in the role**
:
  
  

* Strong hands-on software engineering experience, with a record of designing, coding, testing and operating significant applications or product capabilities.
* Effective use of AI coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to prototype, write, test and review code safely, with an interest in building agents that improve the software development lifecycle.
* Strong Python expertise and practical knowledge of modern engineering practices, including application programming interfaces, microservices, databases, containers, automated testing and continuous integration and delivery.
* Hands-on experience building AI, machine learning or generative AI solutions and taking them from experimentation into secure, reliable production use.
* Practical knowledge of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation, guardrails, observability and responsible AI.
* Sound engineering judgement across performance, security, resilience, maintainability, accessibility, technical debt and production operability.
* Ability to clarify ambiguous requirements, identify the most important parts of a problem and deliver robust solutions with limited oversight.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly, challenge constructively and mentor engineers in a global team.

**Building HSBC’s AI engineering capability**
This is a chance to shape how enterprise AI engineering is built and scaled across HSBC. You’ll create the platforms, patterns and delivery discipline that help teams move from experimentation to production with confidence. The work spans technology and business outcomes with clear accountability for quality, reliability and measurable value. If you’re ready to help set direction for GenAI at enterprise scale we’d welcome your application.
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

**Be a part of our legacy**
Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.
  
  
**Who We Are Looking For**
Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We're hiring a Lead AI Platform Engineer: a lead, hands-on engineer who will champion our AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) across engineering teams and design and build core parts of our AI platform, working day to day with our Pune and US AI platform team.
  
  
The team owns the Agentic AI Platform and drives AI adoption, including AIDLC, across the engineering departments. We don't hand work off after release: the team builds it, ships it, monitors it, and supports it in production.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role, not a team lead or people-management position. You lead through technical depth: owning hard problems, setting a high bar for quality, and helping the engineers around you do their best work.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
You will own technical design and delivery for your areas of the AI platform, and help drive AIDLC adoption across engineering.
  
  

* The Agentic AI Platform: the agentic runtime and LLM gateway.
* Shared platform services: a growing set of services, such as a knowledge base built on a vector database.
* AIDLC and AI adoption: helping engineering teams across departments implement AIDLC, AI coding tools, and engineering automation.

**Responsibilities**

* Make AI-assisted engineering the norm by championing AIDLC, AI coding tools, and engineering automation.

**Technical design**

* Take on the most complex platform work across the AI platform, Databricks, and shared services.

* Contribute to technical planning with the Pune and US teams.

**Hands-on engineering**

* Spend time writing, testing, and shipping code across Python, TypeScript, C#, and Elixir codebases.

**Engineering quality**

* Set a high bar for testing, code review, design documentation, and observability through your own work and reviews.
* Work closely with QA and DevOps so quality is built in, not inspected in.

**Production ownership**

* Make sure what you ship is deployed safely, monitored, and supported in production.
* Help lead the response when something breaks.

**Cross-site collaboration**

* Collaborate closely with the OPTI US team by sharing designs, aligning priorities, and keeping work moving across time zones.
* And other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**
We care about lead-level capability, not a title. Manager experience is not required if you've been the person others go to for technical direction.
  
  

* Lead-level software engineering experience building and running production systems, typically 10+ years.
* Production experience in at least two of Python, TypeScript, Elixir, and C#, and the comfort to pick up the rest.
* A strong testing mindset: you design for testability and treat automated tests as part of the work.
* Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and engineering automation, and a view on how they change the way teams build software.
* Experience working with AIDLC or a similar structured approach to AI-assisted delivery.
* Experience owning services in production, including deployments, monitoring, and incident response.
* Experience supporting other engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussions.
* Clear written and spoken English, and confidence working with distributed teams across India and the US.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience building with LLMs, such as agents, tool use, orchestration, or an LLM gateway.
* Exposure to Databricks, Spark, or large-scale data pipelines.

**Our Stack**

title: Senior Engineer, Agent Harness Engineering (IR-557)
description:
Intellectsoft is a software development company delivering innovative solutions since 2007. We operate across North America, Latin America, the Nordic region, the UK, and Europe. We specialize in industries like Fintech, Healthcare, EdTech, Construction, Hospitality, and more, partnering with startups, mid-sized businesses, and Fortune 500 companies to drive innovation and scalability. Our clients include Jaguar Motors, Universal Pictures, Harley-Davidson, and many more where our teams are making daily impactTogether, our team delivers solutions that make a difference. Learn more at www.intellectsoft.net
  
  
Our customer advises global pharmaceutical and life sciences clients across commercial strategy, clinical development, regulatory operations, and medical affairs. An increasing share of this work is powered by AI agents designed to handle complex scientific and commercial datasets. This role is split roughly evenly between internal research (developing reusable agent harness components, benchmark evaluations, and reliability frameworks) and client delivery (architecting, deploying, and scaling production-ready agentic systems).
  
  
**Requirements**

* Professional Experience: 2-3 years of professional software engineering experience, including substantive work building LLM-based or agentic systems (beyond prompt-level experimentation)
* Production Deployment: Proven track record of deploying user-facing AI applications to production, including operational experience with monitoring, versioning, rate limiting, cost control, and incident response
* Core Software Engineering & Python: Strong Python skills with production-grade test coverage, typing, asyncio, Pydantic, Pytest, packaging, version control, CI/CD, and robust API design
* LLM & Agent Frameworks: Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming, and context window management. Experience building or extending orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, deepagents, OpenAI Agents SDK, or custom harnesses) with a clear view on framework utility
* Non-Deterministic Evaluation: Ability to define success criteria, design evaluation datasets, and systematically evaluate non-deterministic AI outputs
* Cloud & Shipping: Working knowledge of containerization and at least one major cloud provider to ship and maintain services independently
* Communication & Adaptability: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to represent technical positions credibly and thrive amid shifting project priorities.

**Nice to have**

* Domain Knowledge: Prior exposure to healthcare, pharma, or biotech data (clinical trial data, real-world evidence, regulatory submissions, pharmacovigilance, or commercial analytics) and standards (CDISC, SNOMED, MedDRA)
* Regulated Environments: Familiarity with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, GDPR, audit logging, and formal system validation
* Observability & Protocols: Hands-on experience with LLM tracing tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry) or developing and hosting MCP servers
* Retrieval & Models: Experience with RAG pipelines, vector search (pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate), fine-tuning, distillation, or model serving (vLLM, Bedrock, Vertex AI)
* DevOps & Data Engineering: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, GitHub Actions, AWS/Azure) alongside large-scale data processing using Polars, Pandas, DuckDB, and advanced SQL
* Consulting & Ecosystem Engagement: Prior consulting/client services experience, active use of agentic developer tooling (such as Claude Code), or open-source contributions/publications in agent architectures and evaluations

**Responsibilities**

* Harness & Orchestration Architecture: Design and build core agent harnesses, covering function calling, tool interfaces, context assembly, retrieval integration, subagent delegation, retry logic, and failure handling
* Prototype to Production Delivery: Take agentic systems from initial concept to scalable production, managing deployment, monitoring, cost, latency, and operational support against live enterprise client data
* Evaluation Infrastructure: Build and maintain rigorous evaluation suites, task benchmarks, scoring rubrics, and regression tests using tools like Langfuse, Pydantic Logfire, or custom SDKs to drive architectural decisions
* System & Tool Integration: Integrate client enterprise systems, data sources, and internal APIs as accessible agent tools, including building and managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
* Solution Consulting & Requirements Translation: Translate ambiguous client requirements into robust agent architectures, clearly advising stakeholders when an agentic pattern is—or is not—the right solution
* Stakeholder Communication: Interface directly with client stakeholders and articulate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences
* Tooling Transfer & Documentation: Contribute reusable harness components to shared internal tooling and document design decisions to meet audit, validation, and handover standards

**Benefits**

* Employment-based cooperation
* Comprehensive insurance for you and your family (health, life, and accident)
* Paid PTO policy (vacation, sick leaves, and public holidays)
* Tech equipment provided
* Udemy courses, workshops, trainings & expert knowledge-sharing
* Flexible hours & work setup

title: AIOps Platform Engineer Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior AIOps Engineer to design, build, and operate the autonomous agents that turn observability data into safe, closed-loop operational action. You will sit at the intersection of service observability and agentic AI: connecting agents to metrics, logs, traces, events, change data, and service topology so they can detect, diagnose, and remediate production issues with minimal human intervention. You will define how agents reason over telemetry, which tools and runbooks they can call, the guardrails and approval gates that keep their actions safe, and the feedback loops that make them smarter after every incident. This role moves us from dashboards people have to watch to a self-healing production estate where AI observes, decides, and acts — and humans stay in control.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design and build autonomous AIOps agents (LLM-based and multi-agent) that run the full operational loop — observe, correlate, diagnose, decide, act, and verify — across incident triage, root-cause analysis, and auto-remediation
* Connect agents to the observability estate (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Tempo/Jaeger, APM, CMDB, change and deployment events) through well-defined tools/APIs and MCP servers, giving agents real-time, topology-aware context to reason over
* Turn observability signals into autonomous action: build event-driven triggers on SLO burn-rate, anomaly, and correlated alert patterns that launch agent workflows such as rollback, restart, scale-out, failover, traffic shift, config fix, or ticket enrichment
* Build the agent action layer: convert runbooks into machine-executable, idempotent actions (runbook-as-code), with pre-checks, blast-radius limits, dry-run modes, automatic rollback, and post-action health verification against SLIs
* Implement guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls: risk-tiered autonomy levels, policy-as-code, approval gates for high-risk changes, full audit trails, and explainable reasoning for every decision an agent makes
* Apply AI to observability data: anomaly detection, forecasting, alert noise reduction, event correlation, and retrieval-augmented reasoning over past incidents, runbooks, and post-mortems to speed up RCA and cut MTTD/MTTR

title: Machine Learning Engineer / Researcher (IR-556)
description:
Intellectsoft is a software development company delivering innovative solutions since 2007. We operate across North America, Latin America, the Nordic region, the UK, and Europe. We specialize in industries like Fintech, Healthcare, EdTech, Construction, Hospitality, and more, partnering with startups, mid-sized businesses, and Fortune 500 companies to drive innovation and scalability. Our clients include Jaguar Motors, Universal Pictures, Harley-Davidson, and many more where our teams are making daily impactTogether, our team delivers solutions that make a difference. Learn more at www.intellectsoft.net
  
  
Our client is a management consulting and technology firm focused on transforming global healthcare and diverse industries through data-driven strategies, cutting-edge analytics, and advanced AI solutions. This role sits within a focused research initiative dedicated to adapting small language models (SLMs) to specialized, high-value domain applications.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Experience: 3+ years in Machine Learning Engineering or Applied ML, with hands-on experience fine-tuning transformer-based language models
* Core Tech Stack: Advanced Python and PyTorch proficiency
* Frameworks & Ecosystem: Deep fluency in the Hugging Face ecosystem, including Transformers, PEFT, Datasets, Accelerate, and TRL
* Fine-Tuning Expertise: Practical command of SFT with LoRA/QLoRA, alongside the judgment to reason about CPT and RL/preference methods
* Model Selection: Strong understanding of base model architectures, tokenizer design, pre-training data distributions, licensing, and context window requirements
* Data Engineering for ML: Proven experience building training pipelines (curation, cleaning, synthetic data generation, and formatting)
* Evaluation & Serving: Ability to design executable correctness evaluations, paired with hands-on experience serving and quantizing models using at least one modern inference framework
* Research Fluency: Comfort reading recent ML research papers and translating state-of-the-art methods into working code

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with Continued Pre-Training (CPT) on large domain corpora
* Experience with Reinforcement Learning / preference optimization for LLMs (reward modeling, DPO, GRPO, or verifiable-reward setups)
* Experience with structured-output generation, code generation (e.g., SQL/DDL), or domain classification fine-tuning
* Familiarity with distributed training frameworks (DeepSpeed, FSDP)
* Knowledge distillation experience transferring capabilities from large teacher models to small student models
* Experience with on-device or edge deployment
* Active open-source contributions to machine learning tooling, libraries, or published models

**Responsibilities**

* Own the Model Adaptation Lifecycle: Drive end-to-end adaptation of SLMs to specialized domain tasks, choosing the right base models, training strategies, and architectures
* Apply Efficient Fine-Tuning: Implement parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods with a mathematically grounded understanding of low-rank adaptation (LoRA, QLoRA, rank selection, parameterization, scaling, and accuracy-efficiency trade-offs)
* Select Strategy per Task: Determine and sequence optimal adaptation strategies - including Continued Pre-Training (CPT), Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), and RL/preference tuning (DPO, GRPO, RLHF)
* Curate & Synthesize Data: Clean, curate, format, and generate high-quality datasets, including synthetic data generation when domain data is scarce
* Design Functional Evaluations: Build task-specific benchmarks grounded in functional, executable correctness rather than loss curves or perplexity alone, maintaining regression tracking across versions
* Leverage Knowledge Transfer: Use larger models as teachers to transfer capabilities to SLMs via distillation, structured pruning, and quantization
* Deploy & Optimize Serving: Stand up and optimize inference infrastructure across GPU, CPU, and edge targets using frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, or TensorRT-LLM
* Pipeline Reproducibility & Research Execution: Break target tasks into milestones with clear criteria, maintaining reproducible pipelines with data/config versioning, checkpointing, and experiment tracking
* Translate recent literature into reproducible experiments

**Benefits**

* Employment-based cooperation
* Comprehensive insurance for you and your family (health, life, and accident)
* Paid PTO policy (vacation, sick leaves, and public holidays)
* Tech equipment provided
* Udemy courses, workshops, trainings & expert knowledge-sharing
* Flexible hours & work setup

title: Manager - Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with 5–9 years of experience designing, building, and operating production-grade AI and Generative AI solutions. You will provide hands-on technical leadership across solution architecture, data and model pipelines, agentic systems, evaluation, cloud deployment, and observability. The ideal candidate pairs deep AI/ML expertise with strong software-engineering discipline and sound architectural judgment and can lead delivery for complex enterprise use cases.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own AI/ML and GenAI solutions end to end — data pipelines, model and prompt workflows, APIs, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous optimization.
* Design enterprise RAG platforms: secure ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid/vector search, reranking, citations, and access-aware retrieval.
* Build production agentic systems using tool/function calling, structured outputs, planning and memory, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop approvals, failure recovery, and auditable traces.
* Architect and operate MCP clients and servers that expose enterprise tools, resources, and prompts — with secure transports (stdio, Streamable HTTP), authentication, least-privilege access, tenant isolation, and protection against prompt injection and unsafe tool execution.
* Integrate agents with enterprise systems (document repositories, source control, ticketing, databases, ERP/CRM, cloud services) through reusable connectors and governance patterns.
* Define evaluation strategies and quality gates for accuracy, groundedness, safety, latency, and cost, and establish end-to-end observability for agent and MCP activity.

* Partner with product, architecture, data science, security, and business stakeholders; lead design and architecture reviews and mentor engineers.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–9 years developing production software, data, ML, or AI solutions, including hands-on delivery of GenAI/LLM applications.
* Advanced Python and practical experience with data/ML libraries (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent).
* Strong grasp of LLM and agentic architecture: prompting, context engineering, embeddings, RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, orchestration, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Proven experience designing APIs, distributed services, and event-driven or asynchronous workflows with secure tool execution for AI agents.
* Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub and CI/CD, including automated build, test, security-scan, and deployment workflows.
* Strong experience with AWS or Azure and containerized deployment using Docker; Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code experience expected.

* Hands-on production experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) is mandatory — consuming and developing MCP servers, integrating clients with agent frameworks, defining tools/resources/prompts, managing stdio or Streamable HTTP transports, and implementing security, approvals, testing, and tracing.
* MLOps/LLMOps practices: experiment tracking, model and prompt versioning, tracing, evaluation, monitoring, and cost optimization.

**Preferred Experience**

* GenAI or agent frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph/LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Amazon Bedrock Agents, or Azure AI Foundry Agent Service.
* Enterprise search and vector technologies (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, Amazon OpenSearch, or equivalent).
* LLMOps/observability platforms (MLflow or comparable) for tracing, evaluation, prompt management, and governance.

title: ML Operations Engineer - Lead
description:
Job Description: ML Operations Engineer - Lead
  
  
**Department:**
AI & Agent Operations (Day 2), AI Organisation
  
  
**Location:**
Pune, India
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Assistant Director, AI & Agent Operations (Singapore)
  
  
**Team Size:**
2 ML Operations Engineers
  
  
**Work Schedule:**
Rotational Shifts
  
  
**Domain:**
Information Technology (IT)
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced ML Operations Lead to manage the deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and optimization of traditional machine-learning models in production. The role will oversee predictive models across consumer, enterprise (B2B), and network businesses, including customer churn prediction, fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead a team of two engineers in India, ensuring model accuracy, reliability, governance, and operational efficiency while coordinating with the Singapore leadership team. This role focuses on classical MLOps and traditional machine-learning models, not LLMs or Generative AI.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop the India ML Operations team, establishing operational standards, priorities, and delivery timelines.
* Manage production deployment, retraining, validation, and rollback of traditional ML models using CI/CD pipelines and structured validation processes.
* Implement model monitoring to detect data, feature, and concept drift, model decay, and performance degradation; define appropriate retraining triggers and thresholds.
* Establish and maintain model registries and lineage records, including model versions, training datasets, performance baselines, and last-known-good versions.
* Ensure model changes requested by business stakeholders are implemented within agreed timelines and validated before deployment.
* Apply champion-challenger testing, backtesting, and validation gates to ensure model reliability before promoting models to production.
* Monitor model performance using appropriate metrics, including AUC, precision-recall, and other relevant evaluation measures.
* Oversee bias and fairness monitoring for decision-making models, ensuring appropriate transparency and human oversight where required.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering teams on data quality, data freshness, data contracts, and change notifications.
* Coordinate with the Singapore leadership team on deployment schedules, incident management, shared services, and operational standards.
* Report model health, deployment success, operational risks, and portfolio performance against defined KPIs.
* Ensure adherence to data governance, model auditability, and applicable model-risk management requirements.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in ML engineering, MLOps, or data science engineering, including team leadership.
* Hands-on experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining traditional machine-learning models in production.
* Strong experience with model drift detection, retraining pipelines, model validation, and production deployment.
* Proven experience with model CI/CD, model registries, lineage management, and rollback procedures.
* Experience with champion-challenger frameworks, backtesting, and model performance evaluation.
* Strong understanding of model governance, data quality, and bias/fairness monitoring.
* Experience leading engineering teams and communicating effectively with business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with telecommunications-scale data and production ML environments.
* Prior experience managing customer churn prediction models.
* Familiarity with predictive use cases such as fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting.
* Experience with cloud-based machine-learning platforms.
* Postgraduate qualification in ML/AI, Data Science, or another quantitative discipline.
* Experience coordinating with international teams across geographies and time zones.

Key Competencies
  
  

* People leadership, mentoring, and team development.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Sound operational judgment and incident management.
* Effective stakeholder communication and business requirement translation.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands and manage production risks.
* Strong coordination skills in a cross-border reporting environment.

Decision-Making Responsibilities
  
  
**Independent Authority**

* Manage India team priorities and operational standards.
* Initiate retraining, model promotion, and rollback decisions within approved validation procedures.
* Take appropriate drift-response actions and escalate data-quality issues to Data Engineering.

**Escalation To Leadership**

* Enterprise risk acceptance and regulatory considerations.
* Cross-functional priorities and standards affecting the wider AI and data ecosystem.
* Headcount, budget, procurement, and changes impacting other platform or data functions.

Key Challenges
  
  

* Maintaining model accuracy and reliability across a diverse production portfolio.
* Managing drift, model decay, and data-quality dependencies with a lean engineering team.
* Coordinating deployments, incidents, and standards across India and Singapore.
* Balancing predictive performance with fairness, transparency, and responsible model use.

title: Team Lead, Provider Data Operations
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
***We’re hiring an AI-first Operations Team Lead; an operations leader who uses AI to build better workflows, not just talk about its potential.***
As a Provider Data Operations Team Lead, you will lead and coach a team while owning productivity, quality, and SLA performance. You will bring clarity to ambiguous problems, remove workflow bottlenecks, and ensure the team executes consistently against operational goals.
  
  
You will also use AI hands-on in your daily work. You’ll identify repetitive or error-prone tasks, test AI-enabled approaches, balance speed with accuracy and human review, and turn successful experiments into repeatable workflows the broader team can adopt safely and effectively.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of a Provider Data Operations Team Lead:**

* Balance Speed, Accuracy & Human Review: Apply sound judgment to determine where AI can operate independently and where human validation is required. Monitor output quality, surface risks, and ensure AI-enabled processes remain accurate, explainable, and aligned with established guardrails.
* Lead Team Execution & Daily Operations: Oversee day-to-day operations for a team of 8-10 Researchers, Associates, and Senior Associates. Provide clear direction on case handling, workflow interpretation, and complex troubleshooting to deliver consistently against productivity, quality, and SLA targets.
* Manage Workflows & Drive Throughput: Own workload distribution, proactively identify bottlenecks, and reallocate work to maintain flow and meet operational goals. Independently manage complex workstreams with minimal supervision.
* Ensure Quality & Process Adherence: Provide quality oversight through case reviews, audits, and trend analysis. Ensure consistent application of SOPs and policies, address escalations, and maintain high standards across both human and AI-assisted outputs.
* Coach & Develop Team Members: Deliver coaching tailored to individual strengths and development areas. Support onboarding, training, and continuous skill-building, including helping team members use AI tools confidently, responsibly, and effectively.

* Partner with Stakeholders in India and the US: Build strong cross-functional relationships, align on priorities and success measures, manage expectations, and escalate appropriately to ensure smooth execution across time zones.
* Navigate Ambiguity & Drive Continuous Improvement: Break ambiguous problems into clear next steps, use data and experimentation to learn quickly, and create repeatable processes from successful solutions.

People management experience is preferred; however, strong individual contributors with hands-on AI or automation experience and demonstrated readiness to transition into a leadership role will also be considered.

title: Agentic AI Engineering
description:
**Agentic AI- 8-15 Years**

**Location: Bangalore,Pune,Hyderabad,Chennai.**

**Engineering Foundation**

*Non-negotiable. This is what we screen on first, and there is no AI in it.*

* Data modelling across SQL and NoSQL, and a clear view of where each one breaks
* Event-driven architecture in production with Kafka, RabbitMQ or equivalent. Ordering, replay, idempotency, dead-letter handling
* Distributed systems failure modes: partial failure, retries, backpressure, timeouts, circuit breakers
* Caching strategy and invalidation, at a scale where getting it wrong hurt
* Observability. You have instrumented a system, not just read someone else's dashboard
* At least one cloud deeply. Not three superficially
* API and integration patterns against real enterprise surfaces such as ERPs, CRMs and data platforms
* CI/CD, containers, release engineering
* You have owned something in production. On-call, incidents, the whole thing

Agent systems are distributed systems with a non-deterministic component in the middle. If the fundamentals are not there, the AI layer does not survive contact with production.

**AI Engineering**

*Two capabilities that do not come free with an engineering background. These are the ones we probe hardest.*

**Evaluation and Error Analysis**

* You have built an eval set for a non-deterministic system and used it to make a decision
* You can decompose a failure: is this a model problem, a retrieval problem, a data problem or a product problem?
* You debug agent behaviour systematically, with traces and evidence, not by gut feel

**Context Engineering**

* Deliberate management of what enters the model on each turn, and why
* Memory strategy: what persists across steps, across sessions, and what should not
* Tool surface design: what the agent can reach, how it is scoped, what happens when a tool fails
* Cost and latency as first-class design constraints, not something discovered in the invoice

**Consulting and Client Leadership**

*Equal weight to the engineering. This is a client-facing role in a services business.*

* Carry a market point of view on models, tooling and delivery patterns, and translate it into what it means for a specific client, in their language
* Run discovery workshops, solution reviews and delivery cadences with client teams
* Advise clients on standing up their own AI capability: practice structure, operating model, skills, governance, build versus buy, and adoption across their engineering org
* Shape and defend technical proposals, PoC plans and roadmaps. Own the story end to end
* Translate business problems into architectures for CXO-level stakeholders without hiding behind jargon
* Say no when the answer is no. Tell a client when agents are the wrong tool, and be able to explain why

**Delivery and Architecture**

*The work itself.*

* Own end-to-end delivery of AI-native programs, from architecture through production
* Design multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph, CrewAI or equivalent. Agent topology, tool routing, memory, state, fallback and recovery paths
* Integrate agent systems with enterprise systems of record, not toy datasets
* Build RAG where RAG is the right answer, from chunking through retrieval, re-ranking and evaluation
* Run agentic coding workflows with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or equivalent, and lead projects where AI writes significant portions of the codebase while you guide, review and ship it
* Work with MCP and shared-context tooling. Design what agents are permitted to reach and under what controls
* Bring governance into the design from day one: agent identity, privilege scoping, audit, human-in-the-loop, kill switches
* Contribute to reusable frameworks and accelerators the wider practice can use

**Team and Practice**

* Build AI engineering capability across the delivery organisation through mentoring, standards and review quality
* Evaluate new models, frameworks and tooling before the hype catches up, and kill the ones that do not earn their place
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases and practice assets

description:
**Job Description**
Publicis Sapient is looking for Python Developers to join our team of bright thinkers and enablers. You will use your problem-solving skills, craft, and creativity to design and develop infrastructure interfaces for complex business applications. You will build and orchestrate agentic, GenAI-powered workflows that transform how our clients operate – from data ingestion and enrichment to intelligent, LLM-driven automation. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph to power scalable, production-ready GenAI solutions.
* Develop reusable components for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and validation that accelerate delivery across projects.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and traceability across agent workflows to support dependable, enterprise-grade AI applications.
* Implement performance monitoring with tools like LangSmith and apply tuning mechanisms to continuously improve agent accuracy and efficiency.
* Deploy and maintain Python-based GenAI services in production, leveraging Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools for reliable releases.
* Architect secure API communication and access management, using JWT, OAuth, and RBAC, to safeguard sensitive client data.
* Apply NLP, LLM, and retrieval techniques, including vector stores and embeddings, to build context-aware, intelligent solutions for clients.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience:**

* Strong Python fundamentals (OOP, data structures, error handling) with hands-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, or Dask.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and Semantic Kernel, building agent orchestration, memory, and tool-use workflows.
* Proficiency in Python API frameworks (Flask/FastAPI), with experience using IDEs such as VSCode and PyCharm.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, time-series data, and data modeling and schema design.
* Basic integration experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch, plus exposure to vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Chroma) and embedding-based retrieval.
* Proficiency with AWS Cloud Services and production deployment practices, including Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Strong understanding of security & access management – JWT, OAuth, RBAC – and secure API communication.

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**

* Prior work on GenAI, CoPilot, or RAG-based systems.
* Familiarity with marketing data models and real-time customer journeys.
* Exposure to NLP, LLMs, and retrieval frameworks beyond the core requirements above.

**A Tip from the Hiring Manager:**
“AI is evolving fast – join us to work hands-on with big clients, sharpen your skills, and stay future-ready.
  
  
**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**Company Description**
Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

Area(s) of responsibility

Job Title: Data Engineer
  
  
Department: Service Assurance
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to join our Service Assurance function. This role is central to the design, development, and maintenance of our data reporting platforms, and analytical tooling. The successful candidate will combine strong technical data engineering skills with the ability to interpret data and communicate meaningful insights.
  
  
Working across our BI, Snowflake Cortex, and AI-assisted reporting environments, you will build scalable data pipelines, develop impactful dashboards and reports, and leverage tools including Claude (Anthropic) and CoPilot to enhance data interpretation and automate insight generation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain robust data analytic reports and processes to support Service Assurance reporting and analytics needs.
* Develop and publish reports and dashboards in Business Intelligence tools (e.g. Power BI, Snowflake, Tableau, or equivalent), ensuring accuracy, usability, and performance.
* Work within Snowflake Cortex to create, optimise, and manage data models, queries, and analytical workflows.
* Utilise Claude (Anthropic) and other AI-assisted tools to automate reporting, generate data summaries, and produce actionable interpretations of complex datasets.
* Write and maintain SQL scripts, Python scripts, and LLM prompts to support data extraction, transformation, and analysis tasks.
* Perform trend analysis and data storytelling, not just producing reports, but interpreting what the data means and communicating findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate business questions into data solutions.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Proven experience as a Data Engineer or in a closely related data role (e.g. BI Developer, Analytics Engineer).
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake, including Snowflake Cortex for advanced analytics and AI-powered SQL functions.
* Strong proficiency in SQL — writing complex queries, optimising performance, and working with large datasets.
* Experience developing reports and dashboards in BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent.
* Proven experience designing and optimizing ETL pipelines and data architectures, with demonstrable focus on performance and cost efficiency.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude (Anthropic) for data interpretation, prompt engineering, and automated reporting workflows.
* Ability to write and maintain Python scripts for data processing, automation, and analysis.
* Experience creating and refining LLM prompts to extract structured insight from unstructured data or to automate narrative reporting.
* Strong analytical mindset — able to interpret what data trends and patterns mean in a business context, not just produce numbers.
* Proven ability to present data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Cloud AI Security - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Job Title:**
SeniorConsultant - Cloud AI Security
  
  
Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.
  
  
Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
  
  

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**
Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
  
  
**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)
* CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently.

**How You’ll Grow**
At Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands-on experience in the global, fast-changing business world. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs at Deloitte University, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Explore Deloitte University, The Leadership Center.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Deloitte’s culture**
Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.
  
  
**Corporate citizenship**
Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. **Recruiter tips**

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. **Benefits To Help You Thrive**

title: Senior Associate – AI ML Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an AI/ML Engineer with 3–5 years of hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning and Generative AI applications. You will contribute across the product lifecycle—from data preparation and experimentation to API development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines practical AI/ML knowledge with strong software-engineering discipline and a demonstrated ability to build reliable enterprise-grade solutions across multiple industries.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Build and maintain end-to-end AI/ML and Generative AI applications, including data pipelines, model or prompt workflows, APIs, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, reranking, citations, and access-aware retrieval.
* Develop agentic AI workflows that use tools, structured outputs, state or memory, orchestration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop approvals, and failure recovery.
* Integrate foundation models and AI services from commercial and open-source ecosystems; select models based on quality, latency, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
* Implement prompt engineering, few-shot patterns, function/tool calling, structured output validation, and—where justified—fine-tuning or parameter-efficient tuning.
* Create reproducible evaluation pipelines for accuracy, relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost; maintain regression or “golden” test datasets.
* Develop production services using Python, REST APIs, asynchronous processing, and well-defined interfaces; write clean, modular, documented, and testable code.
* Use Git and GitHub for version control, pull requests, code review, issue tracking, and release management; implement CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions or equivalent tools.
* Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and cloud services; contribute to Kubernetes-based deployments, autoscaling, secrets management, observability, and rollback strategies as needed.
* Apply secure AI development practices, including privacy controls, prompt-injection defenses, authorization checks, secrets handling, content safety, auditability, and responsible AI principles.
* Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, software engineers, cloud/platform teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into measurable technical outcomes.
* Create technical documentation, architecture notes, runbooks, and knowledge-sharing materials; participate actively in design reviews, code reviews, and agile delivery ceremonies.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
* 3–5 years of professional experience developing software, data, or machine learning solutions, including substantial hands-on experience with Generative AI or LLM-based applications.
* Strong Python programming skills and practical experience with common data and ML libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of LLM application patterns such as prompting, embeddings, RAG, vector databases, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and agent workflows.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs, working with JSON and schemas, and integrating databases, enterprise systems, or external services.
* Understanding of software-engineering practices: object-oriented or modular design, unit and integration testing, logging, error handling, code review, documentation, and debugging.
* Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub and CI/CD concepts; ability to create or maintain automated build, test, security-scan, and deployment workflows.
* Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization using Docker; familiarity with Kubernetes is beneficial.
* A current, role-relevant AWS AI/ML certification or Microsoft Azure AI certification is mandatory.
* Understanding of ML/LLM evaluation, experiment tracking, model or prompt versioning, observability, and production monitoring.
* Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with one or more GenAI/agent frameworks or SDKs, such as OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph/LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or similar.
* Experience with vector stores or search platforms such as pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or equivalent.
* Exposure to LLMOps/MLOps tooling for experiment tracking, tracing, evaluation, model registry, prompt management, or monitoring (for example, MLflow or comparable platforms).
* Knowledge of SQL and data modeling; exposure to streaming, queues, workflow orchestration, or distributed processing is a plus.
* Experience applying AI to enterprise use cases such as finance, accounting, operations, customer service, document intelligence, software engineering, analytics, or workflow automation.
* Awareness of responsible AI, bias and risk assessment, data governance, secure development, and regulatory or client-compliance requirements.
* Open-source contributions, technical writing, hackathon projects, or a portfolio demonstrating deployed AI applications.

title: Research Scientist - Nemotron India
description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
  
  
We are looking for Research Scientists passionate about large generative models! We are searching for world-class researchers in deep learning and natural language processing (NLP) to join our applied deep learning research team which pioneered the Megatron, MT-NLG, and DLSS projects at NVIDIA. Our team is pushing the boundaries of generative AI by building state-of-the-art large language and multi-modal foundation models and applying them to solve real-world problems. If you are passionate about the latest research and technologies revolutionizing generative AI and want to explore creative new paradigms for applied foundation models such as software assistants and customized multi-modal agents, this team will be a great fit for you. After building prototypes that demonstrate the promise of your research, you will collaborate with product teams to apply your ideas into industry-leading real-world applications.

+ Strong SQL skills, with experience in dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension models, SCD, and analytical data models.

+ Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI solutions with Databricks, including LLMs, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.
