+ Strong experience building RAG solutions using Databricks, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
Company description

PRAAJX Private Limited is a Pune-based technology company building a consumer AI assistant that gets real things done for people. You tell it what you need, by voice or text, and it carries the task out in the background: scheduling, deliveries, calls, and more. People will use it every day, so reliability matters more than demos.

Role description

You will be the first engineering hire and the technical co-owner of v1. You decide how it is built, you build the hardest parts yourself, and you set the standard for the engineers who join after you.

* Own the architecture and technical decisions for v1 of the product, from the first commit to the first thousand users
* Design the agent platform: task planning, tool calling, background execution, retries, and per-user memory
* Write production code every day. This is a hands-on role, not a management role
* Set up the foundations early: repositories, CI/CD, environments, logging, monitoring, and security basics
* Make build-versus-buy calls on APIs and managed services to keep cost per user low
* Set cost and latency guardrails for LLM and voice usage together with the founder, and track them weekly
* Take part in technical interviews and set the quality bar for the engineers we hire next
* Keep a written spec and decision log so nobody has to guess why something was built a certain way
* Push back on scope and help the founder cut v1 down to what can actually ship

Qualifications

* 5+ years building and shipping production software, including at least 1 year with LLM-based features running for real users (not only prototypes)
* Has been the lead or primary engineer on a product that went from zero to real users
* Strong in one backend stack (Node.js/TypeScript or Python) and comfortable across web, mobile, and infrastructure
* Hands-on with agent patterns: tool calling, structured outputs, async jobs and queues, and safe-to-retry operations
* Understands security for personal data: OAuth, token storage, encryption, and least-privilege access
* Cost-aware by habit: knows what an LLM or voice call costs and designs around it
* Can walk us through a live system, repository, or product they built and explain every major decision

Nice to have:

* Realtime voice or telephony experience
* Mobile app releases on iOS and Android
* Familiarity with India's data-protection (DPDP) requirements
* Early-stage startup experience as one of the first engineers

What we value:

* Owner mindset: treats the product as theirs, not as a ticket queue
* Serious and accountable: commits to a date and hits it, or says early that it will slip and why
* Direct: tells the founder when an idea is wrong, with reasons, instead of quietly building it
* Pragmatic: ships a working v1, then improves it with real usage
* Long-term commitment: this is a multi-year build, and we want someone who plans to stay

title: Lead Performance Engineer - (10+ years)-11943
description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.
  
  
**Why join Coupa?**

* Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend
* Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence
* Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced Senior/Lead Performance Engineer with 12+ years of experience to drive system performance, scalability, and reliability across the Coupa platform. In this role, you will lead performance engineering initiatives for enterprise cloud systems and integrate cutting-edge AI/LLM performance engineering and testing methodologies to optimize both traditional microservices and AI-driven platform capabilities
  
  
**What You Will Do:**

* Benchmarking & Certification: Establish performance benchmarks for the Coupa platform and design, implement, and maintain an automated performance certification test harness
* AI & Platform Performance Testing: Design load, stress, latency, and concurrency testing suites for AI/LLM workloads (e.g., token generation speed, TTFT—Time to First Token, inference throughput, model server capacity, and retrieval augmented generation/RAG pipeline performance)
* Troubleshooting & Optimization: Troubleshoot complex configuration, infrastructure, networking, application, and AI/ML model deployment problems impacting system performance or capacity
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Product Management, Development Engineering, AI/ML Engineering, and Cloud Infrastructure teams to determine optimal ways to scale enterprise applications and underlying infrastructure
* System Optimization: Provide technical leadership to improve overall system performance, capacity, reliability, cost-efficiency, and scalability (including GPU/CPU compute optimization for AI models)
* Observability & Monitoring: Monitor and manage production performance using modern DevOps tools, continuous automation, and comprehensive AI observability stacks
* Proactive Analysis: Conduct proactive end-to-end cluster scalability, performance, and exception analysis across multi-cloud environments
* Root Cause & Latency Analysis: Analyze root causes for latency in individual components, database layer, network hops, and AI pipeline dependencies (e.g., vector database lookups, context window processing)
* Continuous Improvement: Continually evaluate opportunities to modernize our platform, improve process efficiency, and maximize business impact
* Thought Leadership: Serve as an evangelist for performance engineering best practices, modern load testing tools, and AI performance frameworks across the organization

**What You Will Bring to Coupa:**

* Experience: 12+ years of hands-on experience in Performance Engineering, Analysis, and troubleshooting of complex production systems.
* Domain Expertise: Deep domain expertise in public cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), distributed systems, microservices architectures, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and enterprise capacity planning.
* AI / ML Performance Engineering:
* Systems & Low-Level Fundamentals: Demonstrated knowledge of system software internals; deep understanding of how locking, caching, concurrency, compute (CPU/GPU), memory, and I/O impact software and AI model performance.
* End-to-End Tuning: Proven track record of performance tuning across infrastructure, databases, platform layers, and application code.
* Observability & APM: Hands-on experience with distributed tracing, logging, and metrics collection using tools like New Relic, Grafana, Kibana, Datadog, and AI-focused observability tools (e.g., LangSmith, Arize, Phoenix, OpenTelemetry).
* Tech Stack Proficiency:
* Leadership & Communication: Proven ability to bring clarity to ambiguous technical scenarios, facilitate architecture reviews, arbitrate high-stakes technical discussions, and make tough recommendations in a distributed global team environment.
* Education: BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
  
  
At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:
  
  
**Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)**

* Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together
* Birthday Time-Off: Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month

*Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.*

title: Technology and Innovation - Data Engineering Manager
description:
**Data Engineering Manager**
Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role — you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A data engineering professional with 8 to 12 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation — you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard.
* You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development — not just code reviews and architectural diagrams.
* Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms.
* Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design — grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python — you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself.
* Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools.
* Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments.
* Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices — with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies.
* Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code — you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team.
* Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs.

**What You'll Do**

* Spend a significant portion of your time writing code — building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions.
* Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks — selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end.
* Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models.
* Own critical and complex implementation work — the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team.
* Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards.
* Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability — not just approval stamps.
* Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components.
* Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline reliability, observability, testing, and documentation — by building the reference implementations yourself.
* Optimize platform performance and manage costs across Snowflake compute, Databricks clusters, and Fabric capacities through hands-on tuning and configuration.
* Implement data governance and security controls across engineering initiatives, ensuring compliance, data quality, and lineage traceability at the code and platform level.
* Stay current with the evolving data platform landscape and evaluate emerging tools through hands-on proof-of-concept work, not just vendor demos.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A career path that shows sustained, hands-on implementation even as responsibilities grew — architect-turned-manager, not analyst-turned-manager.
* Hands-on experience building medallion-architecture lakehouses on Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, and designing and tuning performant Snowflake warehouse structures.
* Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including writing the pipeline definitions and deployment scripts yourself.
* Familiarity with dbt for transformation orchestration, with personal experience writing and maintaining dbt models and tests.
* Exposure to real-time or near-real-time data ingestion patterns (Kafka, Event Hubs, Spark Structured Streaming) through direct implementation.
* Experience with data mesh or domain-oriented data platform strategies is a strong plus.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate architectural trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience running sprint planning, design reviews, and cross-functional delivery coordination.

**About Riveron**
At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client-centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well-being in and out of the office.
  
  
Want to stay connected with Riveron? Join our Talent Community to learn more about our growing firm and be considered for future opportunities.
  
  
**Check Us Out On Social Media**
LinkedIn Glassdoor Instagram Facebook
  
  
*Riveron Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer and believes that we are stronger together through our diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.*
Full time roles are eligible for a full range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, and PTO. A complete description of all available benefits can be found at Riveron's Benefits page at https://riveron.com/riveron-life/. Contract roles are not eligible for benefits.
  
  
**Fraud Alert**
Please beware of fraudulent schemes or impersonations when going through the job application process. A Riveron employee will never recruit via text or extend unsolicited employment offers. Additionally, a Riveron employee will never ask you to exchange money or purchase anything as part of the recruiting process.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*

title: Technology Consulting Manager - AI Engineering
description:

and

* Enterprise Impact: Deliver AI-driven transformation at scale for some of the world’s most prominent companies, shaping the future of industries with your expertise.

* Grow with Exceptional Talent: Work alongside outstanding engineers, data scientists, and AI leaders in a supportive, high-performance culture that values collaboration, learning, and excellence.

* Stay at the forefront of emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends.

**What You’ll Bring :**

* 10-12+ years of experience leading technology, AI, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives within consulting, technology services, or industry environments.
* Proven experience leading client-facing engagements and managing senior stakeholder relationships.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, NLP, Knowledge Retrieval, and modern AI architecture patterns.
* Experience building, deploying, and scaling enterprise AI applications from concept through production.
* Strong knowledge of AI application development, software engineering, cloud architecture, and platform engineering practices.

* Agile project planning and project management experience
* Team management and skill development experience
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Highly motivated, good work ethic and enterprise maturity
* Life science domain knowledge is a plus

**How you’ll grow:**

* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Software Engineering
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
As a Manager, Software Engineering in the Services organization, you will have the opportunity to lead the development of analytics applications that sit atop vast datasets gathered by retail stores, restaurants, banks, and other consumer-focused companies. Innovative product opportunities, modern business questions, and intricate datasets present uniquely challenging problems that we are eager to take on. Mastercard's next-generation platform blends industry-leading analytics, advanced software architecture, and the latest web technologies to face these problems. Our software is required to effectively decipher analytically complex insights from these problems, on which businesses base multi-million-dollar business decisions.
  
  
As a member of the Business Experimentation & Optimization team, you will apply your full-stack development skills to building industry-leading business experimentation software that brings sophisticated analytic techniques to business users around the world. We are rapidly expanding our product offerings and innovating on how we deliver Business Experimentation & Optimization solutions to our clients.
  
  
What is Services organization?
  
  
The Services organization is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base. We combine traditional management consulting with our rich data assets and in-house technology to provide our clients with powerful insights and tools to drive fact-based decision-making. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, our services include consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation, and data-driven information and risk management. While specializing in the payments industry, Mastercard Services also works closely with major retailers, airlines, and other enterprises, leveraging data and insights garnered from within and beyond its network.
  
  
We are looking for passionate, talented technologists who share our vision of empowering our customers to make better, fact-based decisions to join us and help shape our team's growth.
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, and a technology innovation lab. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you.
  
  
Role
  
  
As a Part Of Business Experimentation & Optimization, You Will Build Revolutionary Products That Advance How Businesses All Over The World Seize The Most Value From Their Data. As a Manager, Software Engineer Within The Business Experimentation & Optimization Team, You Will
  
  

* Formally supervise, coach, and develop a high-performing development team
* Provide strategic leadership related to specific applications and systems, or software-development methodologies
* Lead large-scale projects from inception to release
* Lead design of major, complex parts of the platform with high-quality development
* Define state-of-the-art service-oriented software architectures
* Spend 50% of your time on active software development tasks
* Lead planning and scoping features for the team
* Build features used by some of the world's largest organizations to make multi-million dollar decisions
* Critically review the code and guide the team with a focus on improving the code quality
* Play a key role in shaping the direction of engineering processes through working on a small team empowered to organize and run the team as they see fit
* Mentor junior engineers and teammates
* Collaborate across teams with exceptional peers who are passionate about what they do

Ideal
  
  
**All About You**

* Experience managing, coaching, and guiding high-performing software development teams
* Experience with full-stack, data, and cloud technologies such as Databricks, AWS (Data Services + Agentic/ML Services including EMR, Agent Core, Bedrock, etc), .NET/C#, Java, Spring Boot, React, Python, Spark, or similar.
* Experience solving and implementing scalable solutions to solve complex problems
* Experience with AI tools like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc., and their effective usage in PDLC is highly preferred.
* Proficiency with advanced object-oriented programming, design principles, refactoring, microservice development, and databases
* Strong understanding of web technologies and server-side technologies for developing microservices
* Strong understanding of microservices development and integration of microservices with UI technology
* Passion for analytical/quantitative problem solving
* Motivation, creativity, self-direction, and desire to thrive on small project teams
* Prior experience leading a team or mentoring other engineers, both technically and professionally preferred
* Superior academic record with a degree in Computer Science or related technical field
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Mastercard is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. Applicants will be considered and treated without regard to gender, gender identity, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disabled status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups.
  
  
**Our Culture**
**Who We Are**
Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500.
  
  
**How We Work**

* We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
* Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
* Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
* We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.

**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Pune HQ2 team and work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and complex enterprise software. You’ll embed with customer engineering teams and help them transform how they build software with Blitzy. This isn’t a hand-coding or traditional solutions engineering role. You’ll onboard new teams, guide them through the platform, troubleshoot issues, and work with client engineers on architecture and priorities, with the goal of getting each team to run Blitzy independently.
  
  
Our HQ2 FDE team deploys alongside customers around the world, working closely with US-based engineering and customer teams with regular time zone overlap for collaboration and handoffs. You’ll partner with customer stakeholders across regions and help each engagement run smoothly from kickoff to steady state.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy Blitzy into complex enterprise environments, navigating technical constraints and translating customer business goals into practical technical solutions
* Embed with customer teams during critical implementations, partnering with engineering leaders on sprint planning, architecture reviews, technical decisions, and production deployments
* Build production-quality integrations, services, and extensions using Java 17 and Spring Boot 3.x, including Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Actuator
* Build and evolve REST APIs using a contract-first approach with OpenAPI/Swagger, with data persistence through PostgreSQL, Hibernate/JPA, and Liquibase
* Package and deploy containerized services with Docker and manage dependencies through Maven, including BOMs and multi-module projects
* Develop custom solutions, reusable patterns, scripts, and tools that accelerate customer adoption and demonstrate Blitzy’s capabilities in enterprise environments
* Debug complex issues spanning customer infrastructure, integrations, microservices, and the Blitzy platform, supporting production operations, health checks, metrics, and configuration management
* Drive successful POCs and technical demonstrations that showcase advanced use cases, deliver measurable value, and expand into enterprise-wide deployments
* Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, performance, and observability using JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, JMeter, Git, Logback/SLF4J, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Identify recurring customer needs, technical patterns, and expansion opportunities that inform product priorities and enterprise adoption
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate field experience into platform improvements, technical documentation, reusable best practices, and contributions to the core product

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code in enterprise environments
* Deep hands-on expertise with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and Actuator
* Strong experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Maven, Docker, and modern testing practices including JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, and JMeter
* Experience building and operating microservices with CI/CD, cloud architecture, observability, production monitoring, and tools such as Micrometer, Dynatrace, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Knowledge of enterprise modernization and distributed systems, including Java 8 → Java 17 upgrades, monolith → microservices migrations, Kafka, Avro, Schema Registry, caching, and resilience patterns
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum and modern software development practices, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to audiences ranging from interns to CTOs
* Experience in customer-facing engineering, developer tools, AI/ML, or enterprise modernization is a plus, along with technical thought leadership through blogs, talks, or open-source contributions
* Passion for AI-powered software development and willingness to work in person from Pune, India, with overlap for US-based teams

*Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process*

title: Senior Demo Platform Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Demo Platform Architect – Contact Center and Customer Experience**
**Position Overview:**
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements.
  
  
**Core Daily Activities**

* Own and Optimize Demo Environments – Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk.
* Develop New Demo Use Cases – Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities.
* Support Custom Demo Requests – Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations.
* Maintain Product and Release Readiness – Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio.
* Drive Automation and Standardization – Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery.
* Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices – Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments.
* Support Customer-Facing Activities – Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients.
* Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral – Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials.
* Engage with Vendors and Partners – Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use.
* Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance.
* Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios.
* Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team.
* Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations.
* Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio.
* Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction.
* Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience.
* Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk.
* Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS.
* Demo Development: Demonstrated experience creating technical demonstrations, reusable use cases, prototypes, proof of concepts, or reference implementations that translate technical capabilities into compelling business scenarios.
* Platform Management: Experience maintaining shared technical environments, managing releases and configuration changes, troubleshooting complex issues, and proactively improving platform availability and reliability.
* Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, take initiative, work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and globally distributed environment.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent credentials in contact center platforms.
* Industry Knowledge: Experience designing and demonstrating omnichannel contact center solutions, including voice, chat, messaging, AI-driven automation, agent assistance, Workforce Engagement Management, including workforce and quality management, and contact center reporting and analytics tools.
* Customer Engagement: Experience delivering technical demonstrations, supporting customer discussions, and responding to detailed technical questions during customer or prospect engagements.
* Agile Methodologies: Experience working within Agile and DevOps frameworks, including source control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and repeatable deployment practices.

**Senior Energy Market Analyst**

* Experience in scripting, automation, and integrating market datasets.
* Ability to communicate complex subject matter in an easy to understand manner
* Strong commercial awareness
* Top down approach to problem solving – ability to see the big picture
* Strong interpersonal presence and skills - demonstrated ability to build rapport
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills
* Strong listening and presentation skills
* Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively
* Self-driven, results-orientated with a positive outlook and a focus on quality
* Thorough knowledge of standard Microsoft programs – Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Sense of urgency for goal achievement
* Strong desire for personal and career advancement

**Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or equivalent in a relevant field.
* 5+ years of experience in energy market modeling, forecasting, or optimization.
* Extensive experience in PLEXOS or similar optimization software.
* Strong leadership, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

title: Vessel Performance Expert
description:
**Job Description**
**Vessel Performance Expert**
Smart Ship Hub (SSH) is hiring a
**Vessel Performance and Machinery Condition Monitoring Expert**
in Pune: a former sailing Chief Engineer (Marine) with shore-side experience who can turn vessel data into measurable fuel, reliability and maintenance outcomes.
  
  
**Item**
**Detail**
Position
  
  
Vessel Performance Expert
  
  
Function
  
  
Vessel Performance / Fleet Intelligence
  
  
Location
  
  
Pune, India
  
  
Engagement
  
  
Full time or part time
  
  
Core expertise
  
  
Vessel Performance, Predictive Diagnostics, Predictive Maintenance, Condition Based Monitoring (CBM)
  
  
Background
  
  
Sailed as Chief Engineer (Marine) plus mandatory shore experience in vessel performance, Condition based monitoring, Predictive machinery health
  
  
**Purpose and Scope of the Role**
The Vessel Performance Expert is SSH’s domain authority on how ships actually run. The role links onboard engineering reality with SSH’s digital platform, so that performance insights, diagnostics and maintenance recommendations are technically credible to Chief Engineers, superintendents, ship owners & managers.
  
  
The scope covers fleet-wide monitoring of main engine, auxiliary engine, machinery performance and hull, propulsion, supports both customer-facing delivery and the product and data science teams building SSH’s analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Predictive Diagnostics**

* Detect early deviations in main engine, auxiliary engine, turbocharger, boiler and auxiliary machinery behaviour, and identify probable root causes.
* Define diagnostic rules, thresholds and fault signatures with the data science team; validate model alerts against engineering judgement.

**Predictive Maintenance**

* Translate diagnostic findings into maintenance recommendations, spares planning and risk-ranked work orders.
* Align recommendations with PMS, class requirements and OEM guidelines; track outcomes to improve model accuracy.

**Condition Based Monitoring (CBM)**

* Design and maintain CBM programmes covering vibration, lube oil analysis, exhaust gas temperatures, cylinder pressures and bearing temperatures.
* Define sensor and data requirements for new vessels and retrofits; review data quality and flag gaps.

**Vessel Performance**

* Analyse speed, fuel consumption, trim, draft, hull and propeller condition, and weather-corrected performance using noon, high-frequency sensor and voyage data.
* Benchmark vessels and sister ships; recommend operational and technical actions that cut fuel cost and emissions (CII, EEOI, EU ETS exposure).
* Quantify hull cleaning, dry-dock and retrofit impact; produce performance reports for owners, managers and charterers.

**Customer and Internal Collaboration**

* Act as technical interface with customers’ superintendents and Chief Engineers; support presales demos and onboarding.
* Provide domain input to Product and Engineering for features, dashboards and alert logic.
* Mentor junior analysts on marine engineering concepts.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
**Mandatory**

* Sailed as Chief Engineer (Marine) on ocean-going vessels; valid CoC Class I (Motor/Steam) or equivalent.
* Shore-side experience in vessel performance is a must (for example in vessel or fleet performance management, performance analytics or technical superintendency with a performance focus).
* Demonstrated hands-on expertise in vessel performance, condition based monitoring, predictive diagnostics and predictive maintenance.
* Degree in Marine or Mechanical Engineering.

**Preferred**

* Experience with performance or CBM platforms, noon-report and high-frequency data, and OEM monitoring systems.
* Working knowledge of IMO CII, SEEMP, EU ETS and FuelEU Maritime.
* Exposure to Python, SQL or BI tools for analysis.
* Experience working with data science or product teams or customer-facing exposure.

**Deliverables, Engagement Terms and Why SSH**
**Key deliverables and KPIs**

* Monthly fleet performance and CBM reports delivered on time.
* Diagnostic alerts validated with a documented root cause and recommended action.
* Maintenance recommendations accepted and closed by customers; targets to be agreed with the hiring manager.
* Documented diagnostic rules and CBM playbooks added to SSH’s knowledge base.

**Why join Smart Ship Hub**

* Apply sea-going experience to a global maritime digital platform.
* Shape predictive analytics products used by ship owners and managers.
* Work directly with leadership in a growth-stage environment.

*Smart Ship Hub is an equal opportunity employer and evaluates all candidates on skills and experience.*

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Data Platform Engineer**
At Johnson Controls, you will help build and operate the data platform behind OpenBlue, our smart-building platform. In this role, you will build the streaming and lakehouse pipelines that deliver trusted building and energy data to the applications our customers rely on.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer with 3+ years of experience to build, deploy, and maintain pipelines on the OpenBlue Data Platform (OBDP). You will work with Kafka, Flink, Spark, Apache Iceberg, and Snowflake alongside senior engineers, and help run them on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with CI/CD and infrastructure as code. This is a hands-on role where you will own well-scoped features end to end, from code to production, and take on more design ownership over time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain Kafka and Flink streaming jobs for ingestion and transformation.
* Develop and maintain Spark jobs for data processing tasks.
* Write unit and integration tests and contribute to CI pipelines.
* Fix production defects and support SIT, UAT, and deployments.
* Deploy and operate data services and jobs on AKS using Helm and Kubernetes operators.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
* Set up monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for pipelines and services (Datadog, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Support routine database and lakehouse operations, including Iceberg table maintenance and PostgreSQL backups and tuning.

**How You Will Do It**

* Own the outcome with accountability by delivering well-tested features and following through on commitments.
* Stay close to work by understanding how the data you build is used downstream.
* Look for root causes, improve continuously, and raise issues with candor.
* Work as one team by partnering with engineers, QA, and product, sharing context, and asking for help early.
* Use clear documentation and disciplined engineering practices to support consistency and handoffs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in software or data engineering.
* Hands-on experience with at least two of Kafka, Flink, Spark, Iceberg, or Snowflake, with working knowledge of or eagerness to learn the rest.
* Proficiency in Java, Scala, or Python, and solid SQL skills.
* Understanding of distributed systems basics such as partitioning, fault tolerance, and idempotency.
* Experience with Git, code review, and agile/Jira workflows.
* Hands-on AI-assisted development with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar, with a critical eye for generated code.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines in a cloud environment.
* Exposure to Trino, PostgreSQL, or TimescaleDB.
* Experience with React and TypeScript.
* Azure experience.
* Production experience with AKS, Helm, or Kubernetes operators for Flink, Spark, or Kafka.
* Experience with time-series or IoT data.
* Experience with Terraform or Bicep and GitOps tools (Flux or Argo CD).
* Azure networking and security basics, including VNets, private endpoints, Key Vault, and Entra ID.

, a business-critical, SOX-critical platform for global liquidity management.
  
  
The GCE provides our clients with the ability to manage their liquidity globally on an end-of-day and intra-day basis. It is a cornerstone of our Treasury and Trade Solutions, enabling integrated cash management, real-time analytics, and cross-border cash mobilization.
  
  
This is a senior management,

position responsible for accomplishing results through the management of a team, coupled with a large component
**(>50%) of individual, hands-on contribution**

The candidate will have a proven track record of building and supporting high-performing global technology solutions, driving innovation, and delivering industry-defining products. Define and drive the AI roadmap for GCE, from conceptualization through to production, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise goals for liquidity management. title: Applied ML & Forecasting Lead for Freight MNC-Pune
description:
Responsibilities

● Build and maintain the forecasting arms behind one common interface: seasonal baselines, statistical models,

regularised linear models, LightGBM panel models with conformal calibration, and a pre-trained challenger

(Chronos-type foundation model).

● Own walk-forward backtesting, the sealed lockbox, prediction intervals, abstention rules and the router that picks an arm per market segment; hierarchical reconciliation from lane to corridor to index.

● Run the pre-registered signal-validation loop: screening of economic hypotheses, multiple-testing (false-

discovery-rate) control, bootstrap and placebo confirmation, and the out-of-sample gate that decides whether a signal enters the models.

● Graph: evaluate graph features through the same backtest fabric as every other feature; specify what the graph layer must deliver for forecasting; keep the door open for graph neural networks once the gates are met.

● Produce reproducible evaluation reports (skill vs. naive anchor, coverage, Diebold-Mariano) verifiable from a repository tag.

**Must have**

● Time-series, panel and multi-horizon forecasting in production (not only notebooks); LightGBM and regularised regression; temporal feature engineering.

● Rigorous evaluation: walk-forward and temporal cross-validation, leakage detection, point-in-time (as-of) correctness, calibration, conformal prediction, prediction intervals, model comparison.

● Statistics for signal discovery: lead/lag analysis, Granger-type tests, multiple testing and false-discovery-rate control, bootstrap methods.

● Strong Python, SQL, Pandas/Polars, experiment tracking (MLflow or comparable); containers, APIs and cloud basics.

● Can instruct a coding agent to implement a new forecasting arm with backtests, leakage checks and baseline comparison — and then judge whether the result is statistically correct.

**Nice to have**

Hierarchical forecasting and reconciliation; foundation models for time series; graph machine learning (PyTorch Geometric, heterogeneous graph models); basic Cypher; exposure to logistics, freight, commodities or financial time series.

Looking for Someone who has shipped forecasting models to production, not only in notebooks, and whose strength is statistics and time series rather than LLM applications.

**Common requirement**

AI-native engineering is mandatory. Daily, productive use of Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor or comparable agents; breaks work into

agent-ready specs and steers parallel tasks; reads, challenges and corrects AI-generated code; tests, CI/CD and evals as guardrails

(build → test → review → fix → merge → verify); fluent in Git, pull requests and code review; maintains CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md;Independent, remote, fluent English. Agent experience alone is not enough — LangChain/RAG/prompt-engineering profiles are not a fit.

title: Sr. Martech Enterprise System Engineer
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
Avalara's Marketing Technology team is scaling its execution capabilities and expanding its AI capabilities to keep pace with a growing go-to-market engine. The systems that power campaign execution, lead lifecycle management, and marketing operations, Workfront, Marketo, and our leads pipeline, require strong, hands-on technical talent to build, maintain, and continuously improve them.
  
  
This IC4 MarTech Engineer role is for a strong technical leader who can transition marketing capabilities from a digital marketing paradigm to an agentic marketing approach by integrating, automating, and configuring new agentic models and solutions across our enterprise capabilities, building reliable integrations, automating marketing workflows, and ensuring lead data flows accurately from capture to CRM handoff.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Build and maintain integrations between Marketo, Salesforce CRM, Workfront, and adjacent MarTech systems, delivering reliable, well-documented solutions.
* Engineer and optimize the lead lifecycle from capture and enrichment through scoring, routing, and CRM handoff, reducing lead leakage and improving data accuracy across the pipeline.
* Develop and maintain automation for campaign operations, asset management workflows in Workfront, and lead management processes in Marketo, replacing manual effort with reliable, auditable automation.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions by working closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, and Sales Operations to understand needs and deliver working solutions on time.
* Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues across Workfront, Marketo, and the leads pipeline, performing root cause analysis and implementing fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Write clean, maintainable code and configurations following team standards for API design, data handling, error management, and security best practices.
* Contribute to technical documentation by keeping integration maps, data flow diagrams, and runbooks current so the team can operate and onboard efficiently.
* Support peers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and hands-on collaboration, raising the technical quality of the team's output.
* Monitor platform health and proactively flag performance issues, data anomalies, or integration failures before they impact marketing operations

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Qualifications**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, enterprise systems engineering, or a closely related technical discipline have recent hands-on work building AI/ML systems
* Solid hands-on experience with Marketo, including program setup, smart list logic, API integrations, lead lifecycle configuration, and data management.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, including workflow configuration, template management, and automation for marketing or creative operations.
* Experience building and maintaining lead management pipelines, including capture, enrichment, deduplication, and scoring.
* Demonstrated production experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector search/embeddings, or recommendation systems — not prototypes, but systems that served real traffic
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and JavaScript/Node.js, with experience owning AWS Lambda data pipelines from design to deployment.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and modern ML tooling (e.g., MLflow, SageMaker, or equivalents)

**Bar Raiser Expectations**
This role is a Bar Raiser hire. The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Hold themselves and others to high standards of technical quality, data integrity, and operational accountability
* Demonstrate strong judgment when making platform and technical tradeoffs, especially those that affect campaign performance, lead data quality, or system reliability.
* Raise the performance of those around them through mentorship, rigorous code reviews, and clear documentation.
* Simplify complexity, translating ambiguous marketing requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions.
* Challenge assumptions respectfully and bring data into technical decisions.
* Leave every system, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

**AI Expectations**
Avalara is an AI-first company. This role is expected to be an
**AI Bar Raiser**
, not a casual user of AI tools, but someone who embeds AI into how MarTech work gets done and elevates the AI capability of the team.
  
  
**Specifically, This Role Is Expected To**

* Use AI to accelerate development and troubleshooting, including AI-assisted code generation, API debugging, and automated testing for MarTech integrations.
* Apply AI to lead intelligence, leveraging AI/ML-based lead scoring and intent signal processing to improve pipeline quality and Sales efficiency.
* Automate content and campaign operations using AI tools to reduce manual effort in asset creation, QA, and campaign setup within Marketo and Workfront.
* Identify and quantify AI-driven improvements, e.g., reduction in lead processing time, improvement in MQL-to-SQL conversion, or hours saved through intelligent workflow automation.
* Share AI best practices with the MarTech team and Marketing Operations, helping peers adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Apply AI responsibly, with awareness of data privacy, governance, and ethical use standards relevant to marketing data and customer information.

Candidates who cannot demonstrate specific, measurable AI impact in prior roles do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: AI Driven Drug Discovery Research Intern|M.Pharm Pharmaceutical Chemistry + M.Sc Bioinformatics|M.Pharm Pharmacology + M.Sc Biotechnology
description:
Company Description PSPM Technologies Pvt Ltd is a fast-growing technology services company delivering advanced digital and AI solutions across multiple industries. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, India, the company focuses on Generative AI, enterprise software, web and mobile application development, and outsourcing services for global clients. PSPM Technologies works with modern technology stacks such as AI/ML, Python, React, PHP, Node.js, React Native, and cloud-native architectures to build scalable and intelligent products. PSPM also serves sectors such as pharmaceuticals, automobile manufacturing, textiles, chemicals, food processing, agriculture, and service-based industries, supported by solutions like the PSPM ERP Cloud.Role Description The AI Driven Drug Discovery Research Intern role is focused on supporting pharma AI innovation projects, particularly in drug discovery research. This remote internship involves designing and executing research workflows that integrate pharmaceutical chemistry or pharmacology with bioinformatics or biotechnology, depending on the candidate’s academic background (M.Pharm Pharmaceutical Chemistry + M.Sc Bioinformatics or M.Pharm Pharmacology + M.Sc Biotechnology). Day-to-day tasks include literature review, data collection and curation, preparation of datasets for AI/ML models, and assisting in developing and validating proof-of-concept studies for AI-driven drug discovery. The intern will collaborate with cross-functional teams to interpret model outputs, analyze biological and pharmacological relevance, and document findings in research reports and presentations. The role also includes maintaining research records, adhering to scientific and ethical standards, and contributing ideas to improve drug discovery workflows and pharmaceutical process optimization.QualificationsStrong research skills, including literature review, experimental design, and data analysis in pharmaceutical or biomedical domains.

* Laboratory skills relevant to pharmaceutical chemistry, pharmacology, biotechnology, or related disciplines.
* Knowledge of oncology or other therapeutic areas, with an understanding of disease mechanisms and drug targets.
* Basic understanding of medicine and pharmacology, including drug action, dosage, safety, and regulatory considerations.
* Familiarity with clinical trials concepts such as study design, endpoints, and ethical guidelines.
* M.Pharm in Pharmaceutical Chemistry or Pharmacology with an additional M.Sc in Bioinformatics or Biotechnology (or equivalent combination of degrees).
* Exposure to AI/ML tools or bioinformatics software for handling molecular, genomic, or pharmacological datasets is an advantage.
* Proficiency in scientific writing, documentation, and presentation of research findings.
* Pursuing or completed M.Pharm in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, M.Pharm in Pharmacology, M.Sc in Bioinformatics, or M.Sc in Biotechnology.
* For Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Bioinformatics candidates: knowledge of molecular docking, ligand analysis, protein preparation, and computational drug discovery.
* For Pharmacology/Biotechnology candidates: knowledge of disease mechanisms, ADMET concepts, biological plausibility, and drug safety.
* This is a six-month, remote, unpaid research internship.

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

**Why Join Citi?**

We secure and facilitate the global financial system. The platforms you unify will protect trillions of dollars in daily transactions from financial crime and regulatory risk.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. We're looking for a highly accomplished and Senior Technical Consultant with 5+ years of experience to lead the charge on complex AI agentic deployments. You'll be a hands-on leader, shaping technical strategy and ensuring successful outcomes.

A significant part of this will involve architecting and deploying complex AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based intelligent agents and automated workflows, all built on top of the Salesforce platform.

* Data Configuration & Integration : Own the entire data lifecycle, from strategic design of data models to hands-on building of efficient processing pipelines and establishing seamless integration strategies. You'll ensure data is always ready, optimized, and secure for our advanced AI applications, often navigating complex enterprise data environments.

You'll be the ultimate go-to expert for unblocking progress.

* Conduct Deep-Dive Technical Debugging and Root Cause Analysis: Perform detailed analysis, debugging, and root cause identification for complex system interactions, data flows, and AI model behaviors to optimize performance, ensure reliability, and prevent recurrence of issues.
* Lead Rapid Prototyping and Iteration: Quickly develop proofs-of-concept and minimum viable products, often coding alongside client teams to demonstrate capabilities and gather feedback for iterative refinement, setting the pace for rapid delivery.
* Implement and Enforce Best Practices: Directly apply and evangelize engineering best practices for code quality, scalability, security, and maintainability across all deployed solutions, serving as a technical role model.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for high-quality, scalable production solutions in a professional environment
* Strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline
* Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying solutions with Agentforce, including integrating LLMs, applying advanced AI orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering techniques, and experience with agentic frameworks
* Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, integration, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Salesforce Data Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Significant direct experience with the Salesforce platform, including advanced configuration, customization, and complex development
* Demonstrated entrepreneurship, a "get-things-done" attitude, and a focus on fast, impactful delivery, with a proven ability to lead technical initiatives
* Exceptional collaboration, communication, and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Proven ability to lead technical engagements, mentor junior team members, and oversee technical aspects of projects
* Ability to travel upto 60% of the time, as needed to customer sites

**Preferred Qualifications**

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

**technical AI Go-To-Market (GTM) Engineer**
to sit at the core of our revenue engine. This is not a traditional operations role; it is a hybrid of software engineering, data science, and revenue strategy. You will be responsible for architecting an AI-first GTM ecosystem that bridges the gap between Sales, RevOps, Marketing, and Customer Success.
  
  
Your goal is to ensure that every individual in our GTM organization and every piece of our technology stack is augmented by Artificial Intelligence. You will build the bridges that allow us to generate more pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and eliminate administrative friction, all while optimizing our tech spend.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* AI Architecture & Custom Integration
* Design, code, and deploy custom AI integrations from scratch to connect our CRM, Sales Engagement platforms, and other technology stack components.
* Build proprietary internal LLM-based tools to automate account and contact enrichment, outbound messaging for early and middle of the funnel prospects.
* Develop agentic workflows that handle routine administrative tasks (e.g., CRM data, meeting summaries, and follow-up scheduling) across the revenue organization.
* Revenue Ecosystem Optimization
* Partner with RevOps and Marketing Ops to audit the existing tech stack, identifying redundancies where AI can replace high-cost, low-utility third-party vendors.
* Implement predictive modeling to identify high-intent pipelines and provide Sales with real-time "Next Best Action" recommendations.
* Ensure data integrity across all platforms, creating a "single source of truth" that AI models can leverage for accurate forecasting.
* Cross-Functional Efficiency
* Collaborate with Customer Success to build AI-driven retention loops and automated renewal triggers.
* Consult with Marketing leadership on AI-driven content distribution and performance marketing automation to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
* Act as an internal consultant, training GTM teams on how to effectively "prompt" and utilize deployed AI tools to maximize their individual output.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in Marketing/Revenue Operations or GTM Engineering. Deep understanding of the "Leads-to-Revenue" funnel and "Best-in-Class" SaaS ecosystems.
* Ability to write and maintain production integrations — Python, JavaScript, html, or equivalent — connecting AI agents to CRM, MAP, and sequencing tools via APIs. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to ship working code, not just configure no-code tools.
* Deep working knowledge of the modern B2B GTM stack — specifically Salesforce (as CRM and data hub), Clay, Claude, Outreach, Gong or Chorus, etc
* Proven track record of consolidating tech stacks and reducing vendor spend without sacrificing performance.
* Understanding of pipeline math and unit economics: you should be able to work backward from a revenue target to pipeline required, conversion rates by stage, and the specific AI interventions that move each number. If someone says "we need 20 opportunities per quarter at 20% win rate and $75K ASD," you should immediately know where AI can compress that funnel.
* Experience with AI agent orchestration — managing multiple AI agents working different segments or functions simultaneously, resolving conflicts, preventing duplicate outreach, and maintaining data quality in the hub (Salesforce).
* Demonstrated ability to build prompt libraries, training datasets, and refinement workflows for AI agents — treating agent training as a discipline, not a one-time setup.
* Strong opinions on when AI should replace human effort versus augment it — and the judgment to know that bad AI automation destroys deals faster than no automation at all.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD And QAD Redzone**
QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever-increasing disruption caused by technology-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises.
  
  
QAD Redzone helps to enable QAD’s vision for the Adaptive Enterprise. Labor productivity improvements directly impact efficiency. Productive and empowered employees increase the effective capacity of your plant and accelerate time to productivity for new employees giving manufacturers the agility to increase production beyond what was previously possible without having to invest in production equipment or new plants, and reduce the amount and impact of employee attrition. Empowered employees with a growth mindset take extreme ownership of challenges that impact their production goals, creating resilience in the face of disruption.

**Position Summary**

**Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**

Are you an experienced Data Engineer who has led the development of world-class software or digital products? Are you looking for an opportunity to expand your scope and lead products used by some of the biggest and most influential businesses around the world? If the answer to these questions is yes, we would like to talk with you.
  
  
ConvergeCONSUMER™ is a product-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer-focused businesses improve decision-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world’s largest professional services firm.
  
  
We drive value for our clients by optimizing decisions and actions at a level of granularity only made possible with today’s data and technology. ConvergeCONSUMER’s suite of solutions helps consumer-facing businesses prosper in a world being re-shaped by convergence, where the lines between industries, competitors and collaborators, consumers and suppliers, and even human and artificial intelligence have blurred. Our approach for addressing this complexity is simple: we combine Deloitte’s next-generation technology platforms with decades of experience in the consumer sector and a deep understanding of its unique issues and challenges to drive profitability and future growth for our clients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our team. This role requires both technical fluency in data engineering and an analytical mindset capable of assessing data quality and real-world representativeness. The primary focus of this role is to establish expertise on our library of vendor licensed datasets, perform data pulls to extract insights from the datasets, link and join across datasets, assess the datasets and delivered insights for their validity and believability, and enable downstream data users, including account and product teams, to correctly leverage the data according to their project needs. The ideal candidate will have exceptional SQL and Python skills, expertise in Google BigQuery and PostgreSQL, and ability to convey complex data, concepts, and ideas in succinct, clear fashion to various business stakeholders. * Work with Product Managers/Owners to understand how products can be used and should be implemented to solve client problems.

Collaborates with Product, GTM, account, and Deloitte Consulting teams across India and the US.

**Required**

* 10-14 years of relevant consulting experience (or equivalent) with a focus on storytelling and building Model Ready Datasets (MRD) based on analysis of large external and client data sets
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
* Work with Product Managers/Owners to understand how products can be used and should be implemented to solve client problems.

* Partner with external vendors to troubleshoot discrepancies, clarify data definitions, and improve feed quality.
* Ensure compliance with internal governance standards and data-sharing agreements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on external datasets, helping teams interpret and leverage them effectively for analysis and product development.
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.
* Use version control tools like GitHub to manage code changes and collaborate with the team
* Support and coach your team on best solutioning practices, development tools, and pathfinding and surveys for technologies
* Set technical direction, coach talent, enforce standards, align product/engineering/ops, and manage engagement risks
* Advanced user of both SQL and Python coding languages with experience in analyzing large data sets

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree in a related field.
* Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset.
* Familiarity with cloud environments and deployment patterns.
* Knowledge of data engineering best practices and methodologies.
* Knowledge of feature engineering and practical experience working with data scientists on enabling production feature engineering pipelines at scale.
* Previous experience in a similar role within a fast-paced development environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Data Quality, EDA, MRD generation & Governance Ownership
* Cross-Functional Collaboration with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and External Vendors
* Vendor & External Dataset Management
* Technical Depth in SQL, Python, and Cloud Data Warehousing (GCP/BigQuery)

**Why This Role Matters**
Product Forward Deployed Engineers bridge deep product and domain expertise with real client problems. They apply data and AI/ML capabilities to deliver scalable solutions, translate client learnings back into the product, and shape how Converge Consumer turns data into better decisions. It’s a hands-on path to becoming a leader at the intersection of product, data, and client impact.

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
