title: AI Transformation Lead
description:
**In a nutshell**

Loylogic created the global rewards marketplace. Today, we are leading its evolution into the AI era - helping organizations recognize, reward and incentivize their most valuable customers, employees and partners with greater intelligence, relevance and impact.

Loylogic is looking for a highly hands-on AI Transformation Lead to help redesign how work gets done across our company. This is not primarily an AI strategy, research or advisory role. We are looking for a builder with a strong business and process mindset: someone who can quickly understand how work happens today, challenge it, simplify it and then use AI agents, automation and modern technology to make the better way of working a reality.

Working directly with the CEO and closely with the COO, you will have the opportunity to work horizontally across the organisation: Commercial - Sales, RevOps, Customer Success; Marketplace – Partnerships, Marketplace – Performance, Platform, and Corporate (Finance, PE, Legal). Our ambition is not to deploy AI for the sake of AI.

It is to make Loylogic a genuinely AI-native company and materially improve how we work.

**Your mission**

Your mission can be summarized in five words:

DISCOVER → CHALLENGE → BUILD → IMPLEMENT → MEASURE

* Discover — Get close to our teams and rapidly understand how our most important work actually gets done.
* Challenge — Identify unnecessary work, bottlenecks and complexity. Determine what can be stopped, simplified, automated or fundamentally redesigned.
* Build — Personally prototype AI agents, automations and AI-enabled workflows rather than simply recommending what somebody else should build.
* Implement — Work with our functional teams and Technology to turn successful prototypes into solutions that become part of everyday work.
* Measure — Demonstrate what changed: capacity created, cycle times reduced, quality improved, revenue opportunities enabled, costs avoided and other measurable business outcomes.

***How we think about AI and work***

We don’t assume that every problem needs an AI agent.

Before automating an existing process, we want to understand whether that process should exist in its current form at all.

For the processes you work on, we expect you to think along the lines of:

STOP → SIMPLIFY → AUTOMATE/AGENT → BOOST

* Stop: Does this activity actually need to be done?
* Simplify: Can we make the process fundamentally simpler?
* Automate/Agent: Which activities can AI agents or conventional automation perform reliably?
* BOOST: Where should the person keep the work, with AI making them faster, sharper or better informed?
* Where these changes create meaningful additional capacity, you will help quantify that opportunity so functional leadership can determine how it can best be redirected towards higher-value work.

**What you will do**

You will:

* Rapidly map and understand critical workflows across Loylogic.
* Work directly with functional leaders and the people performing the work.
* Identify and prioritise the highest-value AI and process-transformation opportunities.
* Challenge existing processes before automating them.
* Identify activities that can be eliminated, simplified, automated or AI-augmented.
* Personally prototype and build AI agents, automations and internal tools.
* Integrate solutions with existing systems, data and APIs where appropriate.
* Design appropriate human oversight and escalation into AI-enabled workflows.
* Work closely with Technology to move successful prototypes into secure, reliable and scalable production environments.
* Create reusable components and approaches rather than solving every problem from scratch.
* Help teams adopt new workflows and ways of working.
* Measure the impact of implemented solutions.
* Quantify capacity released and identify opportunities for higher-value use of that capacity.
* Maintain a prioritised pipeline of further transformation opportunities.
* Stay close to developments in agentic AI and rapidly experiment with relevant new capabilities.
* We expect you to build, not just recommend.

***What this could look like in practice***

* You might redesign an RFP process so AI handles research, knowledge retrieval and first-draft creation, allowing Sales to spend more time developing the proposition and engaging the client.
* You could reduce the time Customer Success Managers spend preparing client reporting and QBRs, creating additional capacity for performance analysis, upselling and proactive client engagement.
* You might automate elements of supplier onboarding, catalogue enrichment, management reporting, CRM administration, reconciliation, contract analysis or internal knowledge retrieval.
* Sometimes the right answer will be an AI agent.
* Sometimes it will be conventional automation.
* Sometimes it will simply be a much better process.
* And sometimes the answer will be that a human should continue doing the work — but with much better AI support.
* We expect you to understand the difference.

**What you will do**

We are deliberately not looking for an “AI guru.”

We want an energetic, curious, pragmatic and exceptionally resourceful person who enjoys understanding problems, building solutions and getting them into everyday use.

You will probably have around 2–7 years of relevant professional experience, although demonstrated ability matters considerably more to us than years of experience.

***You should bring a combination of:***

* Strong business-process and problem-solving skills.
* Practical experience applying generative AI and LLMs to real business problems.
* Hands-on experience building AI agents and automated workflows.
* Ability to work with APIs, structured data and business systems.
* Working knowledge of Python or comparable scripting/development capabilities.
* Experience with modern automation/orchestration platforms and AI development tools.
* Understanding of RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompting and agentic architectures.
* An understanding of when human oversight is required in AI-enabled workflows.
* Enough technical depth to build independently while recognizing when enterprise engineering support is required.
* Strong commercial judgement and an ability to prioritize according to business value.
* Excellent communication skills and an ability to understand unfamiliar business areas quickly.
* A strong bias towards experimentation, prototyping and shipping.
* Experience in loyalty is not required. Experience in a fast-moving technology company, SaaS business, marketplace, fintech, scale-up, AI company or entrepreneurial environment would be particularly relevant.

***How you think***

When someone explains a complicated process, your instinct is to ask: “Can you show me how you actually do this today?”

* You don’t automatically assume AI is the answer.
* You first understand the problem, challenge the process and determine the best way of doing the work. Then you build.
* You are equally comfortable discussing a business problem with the CEO or COO, sitting with someone in Finance to understand a reconciliation process, or spending the afternoon building and testing an agent yourself.
* You like autonomy, speed and accountability.

***What this role is not***

This is not a Chief AI Officer role.

* It is not primarily about producing AI strategies, PowerPoint presentations, running innovation workshops or managing large transformation programs.
* Nor is success measured by how many AI agents we deploy.
* This is a hands-on role focused on redesigning work and delivering measurable business outcomes, using AI and automation wherever they are the best tools for the job.

***What success looks like***

During your first 90 days, we would expect you to have developed a practical understanding of the highest-value transformation opportunities across Loylogic, created a prioritized pipeline, redesigned several meaningful workflows and already built and deployed the first AI-enabled solutions.

From there, we will measure success through tangible outcomes including:

* Productivity gained • cycle times reduced • quality improved • commercial capacity created • scalability increased • costs avoided or reduced • employee adoption • measurable revenue opportunities enabled
* Ultimately, we want to combine great people, better processes and increasingly capable AI so that Loylogic can achieve materially more with the organization we have.

**What we offer**

Loylogic is an international business with colleagues, clients and partners located across the world. We combine global scale with an entrepreneurial culture in which people are encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge established thinking and take ownership of meaningful outcomes.

You will join a business shaping the future of AI-powered rewards and engagement, working with recognized global brands and sophisticated loyalty programs across multiple industries and markets. Our goodies for you

Our benefits include:

* Highly-attractive bonus scheme
* Competitive salary dependent on experience
* Hybrid working model (mix of office and home office)
* Own points-based incentive program

And many more benefits.

title: Principal Engineer (Clean Water Modelling)
description:

Your impact
  
  
At Jacobs, we push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter, more connected, and more sustainable. In our water business, that means supporting UK water companies in delivering resilient and efficient clean water networks through advanced modelling, analytics, and digital solutions.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer in Clean Water Modelling, you will play a pivotal role in delivering AMP programme outcomes, helping clients optimise network performance, enhance resilience, and meet regulatory and customer service objectives.
  
  
**Key duties include**

* Provide technical leadership in clean water network modelling across UK water utility projects.
* Lead development, calibration, and validation of hydraulic models for large-scale clean water distribution networks.
* Deliver modelling studies aligned with AMP programmes and regulatory performance requirements.
* Undertake and review

+ Demand forecasting and distribution input analysis
+ Network capacity assessments and hydraulic performance evaluations
+ Pressure management and operational optimisation studies
+ Leakage analysis and reduction strategies
+ Network resilience and outage scenario analysis

* Lead optioneering and system optimisation, including network reinforcement, rezoning, and operational improvements.
* Support development of

+ WRMP (Water Resource Management Plans) inputs
+ Investment planning and business cases (e.g., PR submissions)

* Prepare and review technical reports, modelling documentation, and analysis outputs in line with UK water industry standards.
* Ensure modelling outputs align with regulatory frameworks (OFWAT, DWI, Environment Agency).
* Establish and enforce modelling standards, QA/QC processes, and best practices.
* Perform technical assurance reviews of models, data inputs, assumptions, and outputs.
* Engage with UK water company clients, supporting model reviews, technical workshops, and decision-making discussions.
* Identify data gaps, uncertainties, and risks; define strategies for improvement and mitigation.
* Mentor and guide engineers and modellers, supporting capability development within the team.
* Drive innovation through digital tools, automation, scripting, and data-driven workflows.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects****
**.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* Primary Modelling Tools InfoWorks WS Pro, Synergi
* Additional Tools (Preferred) InfoWater
* GIS Platforms ArcGIS Pro, QGIS
* Data & Analytics Advanced Excel, Power BI (desirable), Python scripting (desirable)

**Key Behaviours**

* Strong technical authority in clean water modelling and network analysis.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities with attention to detail.
* Confident communicator with strong client engagement skills.
* Collaborative and proactive in a multidisciplinary and global delivery environment.
* High ownership of quality, data integrity, and technical excellence.
* Mentorship-driven mindset with focus on team capability development.

**Work Experience**

* Over 15 years of experience in clean water network modelling and planning, with strong focus on UK water utility projects.
* Deep expertise in InfoWorks WS Pro and/or Synergi for large-scale hydraulic modelling.
* Experience delivering modelling studies aligned with AMP cycles (AMP6/7/8).
* Strong understanding of

+ UK water industry standards and modelling practices
+ Regulatory frameworks (OFWAT, DWI, Environment Agency)
+ Asset management and investment planning processes

* Demonstrated experience in

+ Network optimisation and pressure management
+ Leakage analysis and reduction
+ Network resilience and scenario modelling

* Proven capability in technical leadership, QA/QC, and mentoring modelling teams.
* Experience in client engagement, technical reviews, and stakeholder discussions.
* Experience in data analysis, interpretation, and model-driven decision support.

Familiarity with digital delivery, automation, and advanced analytics is desirable
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in Water Resources / Environmental Engineering (or relevant field)

**Preferred Attributes**

* CIWEM Accreditation
* Experience working within UK frameworks or with water utility clients
* Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential for client-facing responsibilities.

Ability to work effectively within global delivery teams supporting UK clients.
  
  
**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. In AI and Infrastructure, we shape the future of hyperscale computing by inventing and creating world-leading future technology, and drive global impact by contributing to Google infrastructure, from software to hardware (including building Vertex AI for Google Cloud). We work on complex technologies at a global scale with key players in the AI and systems space. **Job Description**
**Job Summary**
UBISOFT is seeking an Intermediate R&D Engineer to prototype and validate new technologies that improve game testing and quality control. This role focuses on building rapid prototypes and running experiments using GenAI, VLMs (Vision-Language Models), and AI/ML to explore automation opportunities across QC. * Implement data pipelines for experiments: data collection, cleaning, labeling support, and dataset versioning (as needed for proofs-of-concept).
* Explore and compare approaches and document trade-offs.

**Core Competencies**

* Eager to Learn: Highly motivated and quick to grasp new concepts.

* Pragmatic Engineering: Delivers prototypes that are usable and measurable, without over-engineering.
* Analytical Thinking: Interprets results critically; understands bias, variance, and common evaluation pitfalls.
* Collaboration: Works well with technical and non-technical stakeholders; communicates trade-offs clearly.
* Adaptability: Keeps pace with rapidly evolving AI/ML tooling and best practices.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**Role: AI/ML Engineer**

**About Us:**

AppZen is the leader in autonomous spend-to-pay software. Its patented artificial intelligence accurately and efficiently processes information from thousands of data sources so that organizations can better understand enterprise spend at scale to make smarter business decisions. It seamlessly integrates with existing accounts payable, expense, and card workflows to read, understand, and make real-time decisions based on your unique spend profile, leading to faster processing times and fewer instances of fraud or wasteful spend. Global enterprises, including one-third of the Fortune 500, use AppZen’s invoice, expense, and card transaction solutions to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their businesses. To learn more, visit us at
www.appzen.com
.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an
**AI/ML Engineer**
with 1–3 years of experience to join our growing AI team. In this role, you will build and ship the
**LLM-powered and agentic features**
that read, understand and make decisions on invoices, expense reports and card transactions for some of the world’s largest finance teams. You will work alongside senior AI/ML engineers, data scientists and product managers to take features from prototype to production, and own them once they are live. If you enjoy turning the latest advances in LLMs and agents into reliable and measurable products, AppZen is the place for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **LLM & Agent Development:**

* **Tool Use & Structured Outputs:**
  Implement function calling and API integrations so that models can reliably query internal services and ERP/AP systems, and return validated, structured (JSON) outputs.
* **Evaluation & Quality:**
  Build evaluation datasets, metrics and automated test suites to measure accuracy, hallucination rate, latency and cost, and use the results to improve prompts, retrieval and models.
* **Production Engineering:**
  Package and deploy models and services using Docker and CI/CD pipelines, add monitoring and logging, and keep them reliable, scalable and cost-efficient in production.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with senior engineers, data scientists and product managers to turn customer and business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions, and contribute to code reviews and design discussions.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* **Professional Experience:**
  1–3 years of experience building and deploying ML/AI solutions in production, including at least 1 year of hands-on work on LLM-based applications.
* **Programming:**
  Strong
  **Python**
  skills, with experience writing clean, tested, production-grade code and building REST APIs (e.g., FastAPI or Flask).
* **LLM & Agent Frameworks:**
  Hands-on experience with
  **LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex**
  or similar frameworks, and with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) or open-source models.
* **RAG & Vector Databases:**
  Practical experience building RAG pipelines using vector databases such as
  **Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS**
  .
* **Prompting & Structured Outputs:**
  Good understanding of prompting techniques (few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, ReAct) and of getting reliable structured outputs and function calls from LLMs.

  Solid grounding in ML and NLP fundamentals, with working experience in
  **PyTorch**
  or a similar framework. Exposure to fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA) is a plus.
* **MLOps & Cloud:**
  Working knowledge of Docker, Git and CI/CD, and experience deploying on a cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure). Familiarity with LLM observability tools (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights & Biases) is a plus.
* **Good to Have:**
  Experience with document AI (OCR, invoice or receipt data extraction) or with finance, accounts payable or expense data.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
Ampere is hiring a senior individual contributor to build the engineering foundation for enterprise AI. The role covers platform services, knowledge and retrieval systems, MCP integrations, and agent workflows.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role. You will make design decisions, write production code, establish technical standards, and remain accountable for the systems after release. You will work with engineering, data, IT, security, and business teams to deliver AI capabilities that are secure, reliable, and useful.
  
  
**What you’ll achieve:**

* Build and operate shared services, APIs, automations, and integrations that allow teams to use approved AI models, enterprise data, and business tools.
* Improve reliability, performance, deployment, monitoring, logging, incident response, and operating documentation.
* Set implementation standards and build common components that reduce duplicated work across AI initiatives.
* Develop embedding, indexing, and retrieval methods for technical and enterprise knowledge.
* Improve search quality through hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, access-aware retrieval, reranking, query processing, source citations, and evaluation.
* Apply appropriate data structures and algorithms to search, ranking, caching, state management, and performance.
* Build test sets and measurement methods for retrieval accuracy, grounding, latency, cost, and failure handling.
* Design and implement MCP clients, servers, and tool integrations for enterprise systems.
* Define tool interfaces, schemas, authentication, authorization, approval flows, audit records, and lifecycle practices.
* Build and maintain integrations with engineering, knowledge, ticketing, source-control, data, and business systems.
* Maintain a managed tool catalog with ownership, access controls, versioning, test coverage, monitoring, and retirement practices.
* Build agent workflows that plan tasks, call tools, retain execution state, request approval when needed, and recover from failure.
* Implement scheduling, retries, checkpoints, cancellation, escalation, and human review for long-running work.
* Set controls for agent permissions, credential scope, tool risk, evidence capture, and auditability.
* Measure task completion, tool outcomes, workflow quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
* Apply enterprise identity and security requirements across AI services, including OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, managed identities, RBAC, secrets management, and least-privilege access.
* Address prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool access, excessive permissions, and poor source provenance.
* Work with security and platform teams to maintain the controls, monitoring, and operating practices required for enterprise AI

**About you:**

* M.Tech in Computer Engineering or related field with 3+ years of experience or B.Tech in Computer Engineering or releated field with 5+ years of experience
* 3+ years of experience building production software, platform services, developer tools, data systems, or applied AI products.
* Strong software-engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, API design, schema design, asynchronous systems, testing, debugging, and performance analysis.
* Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, plus experience building and maintaining React applications.
* Experience building APIs, integrations, background jobs, automations, and services that use enterprise authentication and authorization.
* Experience with LLM applications, tool calling, structured outputs, semantic search, retrieval systems, or agent workflows.
* Experience with embeddings, hybrid search, metadata design, ranking, access-aware retrieval, retrieval evaluation, and vector or search infrastructure.
* Experience with MCP or comparable tool-integration protocols, including tool contracts, schemas, authentication, authorization, and lifecycle management.
* Experience designing reliable workflows with state management, retries, idempotency, checkpoints, cancellation, and audit trails.
* Working knowledge of Linux, Git, Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment, monitoring, logging, and production incident response.
* Sound security judgment across identity, access control, secrets, sensitive data, and AI-specific threats

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Rust and Tauri experience, or experience building native desktop applications.
* Azure experience, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, and Azure VMs.
* Experience with search and vector platforms such as Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, or Chroma.
* Experience with workflow orchestration, event-driven systems, queues, schedulers, state machines, or durable execution platforms.
* Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, Bicep, or similar tools.
* Experience with Redis, caching, rate limiting, telemetry, usage analytics, capacity planning, or cost management.
* Experience with pytest, Vitest, Playwright, contract testing, integration testing, or AI evaluation frameworks.
* Experience in semiconductor, advanced computing, developer platform, or enterprise engineering environments.

**What We’ll Offer**
At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
  
  
**Benefits Highlights Include**

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.
  
  
Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications And Experience**
Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.

Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.

GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

title: Senior SAP AI Architect
description:
Senior SAP AI Architect

Location: Anywhere in India

Job Description:

Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on SAP AI Architect to lead the strategy, design, and implementation of

next-generation Enterprise AI solutions. In this role, you will be the technical anchor for our AI transformation,

focusing heavily on building intelligent agents and digital assistants.

The ideal candidate possesses a unique blend of deep enterprise architecture knowledge and extensive

hands-on experience deploying AI via both low-code frameworks (e.g., Joule Studio) and pro-code engineering

(e.g., custom LLM orchestration and frameworks) within the SAP BTP ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Agent Orchestration

• End-to-End Agentic AI: Design and deliver architectures that integrate seamlessly with SAP S/4HANA,

SAP SuccessFactors, and non-SAP systems.

• Multi-Agent Systems: Architect workflows using foundational/advanced communication methodologies,

ensuring interoperability via the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol.

• Tool Integration: Standardize landscape interaction by implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for

secure internal and external tool interactions.

• AI Governance: Govern the lifecycle using the SAP LeanIX AI Agent Hub to discover, optimize, and manage

enterprise-wide AI capabilities.

Low-Code Assistant Delivery

• Digital Assistants: Build, configure, and seamlessly register corporate digital assistants via Joule Studio in

SAP Build.

• Visual Workflows: Utilize drag-and-drop interfaces to design complex business workflows, managed

runtimes, and automated tasks without traditional code.

Pro-Code AI Engineering

• Custom AI Engines: Develop high-performance AI engines using the SAP Cloud SDK for AI via Python,

Java, or TypeScript.

• Advanced Orchestration: Orchestrate multi-agent behaviors, memory systems, and custom tool-calling

using frameworks like LangGraph or CrewAI.

• Cloud Deployments: Deploy containerized custom AI microservices efficiently on cloud runtimes like Kyma

or SAP BTP Cloud Foundry.

Data & Core Infrastructure Integration

• Model Orchestration: Leverage SAP AI Core and the Generative AI Hub to securely orchestrate,

benchmark, and deploy large language models (LLMs).

• Enterprise RAG: Implement advanced retrieval mechanisms using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG),

capitalizing on the SAP HANA Cloud Vector Engine and Knowledge Graph Engines.

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

Core SAP AI Stack

• SAP Platform: Hands-on mastery of SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry / Kyma), CAP Framework, and SAP

Integration Suite.

• AI Control Plane: In-depth working experience with SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, AI Launchpad, and

Joule.

• Low-Code Toolkit: Complete proficiency in Joule Studio and the SAP Build suite.

Pro-Code & Engineering Frameworks

• Languages: Strong, production-grade programming skills in Python (required) along with Node.js/TypeScript

or Java.

LangGraph, CrewAI, LlamaIndex).

• Data Tiering: Expert knowledge of Vector Databases, semantic search, prompt engineering, and graph

technologies.

Integration & DevOps

• APIs & Protocols: Mastery of OData, REST, Event-Driven Architectures, A2A protocols, and MCP (Model

Context Protocol).

• Cloud Native: Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker containerization, and enterprise CI/CD pipelines.

Experience & Education Requirements

• Overall IT Experience: Minimum of 8+ years in enterprise software architecture and engineering.

• AI/SAP Specific Experience: At least 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience designing and deploying

Generative AI or Agentic AI systems, specifically within an SAP context.

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a heavily quantitative field.

• Certifications (Preferred): SAP BTP certifications, SAP AI specialized credentials, or formal cloud platform

architect certifications.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
We're Hiring: AI/ML Engineer
  
  
**Vowels of the People Association (VOPA)**
**Location:**
Kothrud, Pune (In-Office)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Experience:**
0–3 Years (Freshers Welcome)
  
  
**Salary:**
Based on demonstrated skills
  
  
**Apply at:**
https://careers.vopa.in
  
  
**About VOPA**
Vowels of the People Association (VOPA) is a Pune-based organization working at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and education technology for social impact.
  
  
Our flagship product,
**NIPUN Maharashtra**
, powers foundational literacy and numeracy assessments across
**70,000+ schools in Maharashtra, serving 5 million students**
.
  
  
We build AI that works for underserved populations — real classrooms, real children, real impact.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a passionate and technically strong
**AI/ML Engineer**
to join our team.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role with a research orientation. You will work on fine-tuning open-source models, designing machine learning pipelines, and deploying production-ready AI systems at scale.
  
  
**Our Key Focus Areas Include**

* Handwritten answer evaluation
* Marathi Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
* Computer Vision for Indic scripts
* Low-resource language AI models
* Efficient cloud and on-device AI inference

**What makes this role exciting?**
We have already shipped a fine-tuned vision model (Gemma 4 31B using Unsloth and LoRA) that surpasses many state-of-the-art models on Marathi children's handwriting recognition.
  
  
You will build on this foundation, improve existing systems, and explore new approaches to solving challenging AI problems.
  
  
**Important:**
This is not a data annotation or prompt engineering role. We are looking for someone who understands how machine learning models work internally.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Model Fine-Tuning & Training
* Fine-tune open-source LLMs and vision models using LoRA, QLoRA, and other Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) techniques.
* Work with Hugging Face Transformers, Unsloth, and PEFT libraries.
* Optimize GPU training performance and resource utilization.
* Experiment with model architectures for domain-specific educational applications.
* Computer Vision & Speech AI
* Develop models for Marathi handwriting recognition and answer evaluation.
* Work on speech recognition systems for Marathi and other Indic languages.
* Design AI-based rubric scoring and evaluation mechanisms.
* Handle noisy, inconsistent, and low-resource real-world datasets.
* Model Deployment & Optimization
* Deploy fine-tuned models to AWS infrastructure, including ECS/Fargate and GPU inference endpoints.
* Optimize inference performance, latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost.
* Explore quantization, batching, ONNX, TensorRT, and other inference optimization techniques.
* Investigate on-device AI deployment for Android applications.
* ML Pipelines & Evaluation
* Build end-to-end ML pipelines covering data preprocessing, augmentation, training, evaluation, and serving.
* Define and track evaluation metrics such as Word Error Rate (WER), Character Error Rate (CER), and Devanagari-aware benchmarks.
* Perform structured error analysis to identify model weaknesses.
* Improve model reliability and accuracy through systematic experimentation.
* Research & Engineering Collaboration
* Read and evaluate recent AI/ML research papers.
* Translate research ideas into practical experiments and production implementations.
* Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate AI models into FastAPI services.
* Contribute to technical decisions regarding model architecture, training, and deployment.

**Required Technical Skills**
Model Fine-Tuning & Deep Learning
  
  

* Strong understanding of Transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, embeddings, and positional encoding.
* Knowledge of encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder architectures.
* Hands-on experience with LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning using Hugging Face PEFT or Unsloth.
* Understanding of model quantization techniques such as NF4, GPTQ, and AWQ.
* Familiarity with learning rate scheduling, gradient accumulation, and mixed-precision training.
* Ability to diagnose training instability, loss spikes, and gradient-related issues.

ML Engineering & Programming
  
  

* Good programming skills in Python or Rust.
* Proficiency in PyTorch, including autograd, tensor operations, and custom loss functions.
* Experience with Computer Vision (CNNs, image preprocessing, augmentation) and/or Speech AI (CTC, attention-based models, audio feature extraction).
* Understanding of dataset preparation, labeling strategies, and train/validation/test splits.
* Ability to write clean, modular, production-oriented code.

Model Deployment & Inference
  
  

* Experience deploying ML models using Docker and cloud infrastructure.
* Familiarity with GPU-based inference environments.
* Understanding of inference optimization, batching, ONNX, TensorRT, and KV caching.
* Awareness of model size, latency, and runtime constraints for edge devices.
* Ability to balance inference cost, latency, and throughput.

**Preferred Skills (Not Mandatory)**

* Experience using Unsloth for efficient model fine-tuning.
* Familiarity with Marathi, Devanagari, or multilingual NLP/ASR systems.
* Experience working with children's handwriting or speech datasets.
* Knowledge of AWS services such as ECS, S3, CloudFront, and Lambda.
* Exposure to model watermarking, AI model security, or on-device inference protection.

Who Can Apply?
  
  
**We Welcome Applications From**

* Freshers with strong practical AI/ML skills and demonstrable projects.
* Engineers with 0–3 years of relevant experience.
* Candidates who have independently fine-tuned or deployed ML models.
* Individuals who enjoy research, experimentation, and solving real-world engineering challenges.

**A Specific Degree Or Certification Is Not Required.**
We value demonstrated technical skills, problem-solving ability, and hands-on experience over academic credentials.
  
  
Our Selection Process
  
  
Our hiring process is entirely skill-based.
  
  
Candidates will be evaluated through a
**practical technical assessment**
designed to test their understanding of AI/ML concepts and their ability to solve real engineering problems.
  
  
Degrees and certifications will not determine selection.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  

* Real-world impact: Build AI systems used across 70,000+ schools, reaching millions of children.
* Meaningful engineering challenges: Work on low-resource languages, handwritten text recognition, speech AI, and edge deployment.
* Technical ownership: Take responsibility for research, development, optimization, and deployment.
* Collaborative environment: Work with a technically strong, mission-driven team.
* Growth opportunities: Contribute to AI research and architectural decisions as VOPA scales.
* High autonomy: We value outcomes, independent thinking, and engineering excellence.

Apply Now
  
  
Interested in building AI systems that create meaningful educational impact?
  
  
**Submit Your Application Through Our Official Careers Portal**
https://careers.vopa.in
  
  
**Applications are accepted only through the VOPA Careers Portal.**
**Vowels of the People Association (VOPA)**
*Building technology for meaningful social impact.*
Salary Range
  
  
4.00 - 5.00 LPA

title: Product Engineer (Junior)
description:
**Product Engineer (Junior) — VenXR**
VenXR builds AdsGPT: brands plan, run and optimise their ad campaigns by talking to it. We're hiring a Product Engineer, one to two years in, who builds
*with*
LLMs rather than around them.
  
  
**What You'll Build**
Features, end to end — from a half-formed idea to production, and you own what happens after it ships. Most of what you build will have a model in the loop: campaign planning that reasons about a brand's goals, interfaces that assemble themselves from whatever the model surfaced, agents calling real tools against real ad platforms.
  
  
**Tech Stack**
Frontend: React.js
  
  
Backend: Python, Django
  
  
AI: Claude and other frontier models, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP
  
  
**AI-native, and we mean it literally**
Most job ads get this wrong, so plainly: using Claude to write code is not what we mean. Everyone does that. We mean LLMs as the material the product is built from. You'll need working knowledge of:
  
  

* Fundamentals — tokens, context windows, cost, latency, structured outputs, why a confident model is often wrong
* Orchestration — LangGraph or equivalent: state, nodes, conditional routing, persistence, interrupts. Not just prompts in a for loop
* Multi-agent patterns — when splitting work across agents helps, and the commoner case where it just multiplies failure modes
* Context engineering — what the model sees at each step: retrieval, compaction, selective injection. Where most of the quality lives
* Memory management — multi-turn state without the window or the bill growing unbounded
* MCP — connecting models to tools and APIs
* Evaluation — knowing whether what you built works, which is harder than building it

What we want is someone who has built at least one real thing with an orchestration framework — past the tutorial, into the part where it broke. Self-taught side projects count; show us.
  
  
**What You Need**

* One to two years shipping product
* React.js, Python with Django — or FastAPI plus the obvious ability to get to Django in a fortnight.
* At least one LLM-backed feature real users touched, where you owned the prompt, the orchestration and the failure modes
* REST APIs, SQL or NoSQL, and enough system design to know when your approach won't survive scale
* Strong debugging, and comfort with ambiguity and almost no hand-holding

Your work speaks louder than your degree. Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, or projects you’ve shipped. That’s what we’ll look at first.
  
  
**What Helps**
Each one moves you up the list.
  
  

* Conversational interfaces, and multi-turn state across channels
* LLM evaluation and monitoring — Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or your own harness
* Working knowledge of Generative UI.
* AdTech, MarTech domain knowledge is a plus.
* Cloud infra, Docker, CI/CD
* Explainable or compliance-aware AI in a regulated domain

**How We Work**

* Customer obsession — curiosity about what your code does to someone's day
* Ownership — chase blockers rather than wait on them
* Stakeholder sense — know when to pull in Product, Design or Business
* High standards — hold your work to a bar nobody is checking
* Disagree and commit — argue the call hard, then back it fully
* Simplify relentlessly — the simplest thing that works beats the cleverest thing that works
* Solidarity — show up for teammates unasked
* Vitality — energy that holds up in month six

In practice: ship fast, test in production more than is strictly comfortable, and sit close enough to the founders that "I'll ask Product" means turning around.
  
  
**The process**
The take-home is the real filter, so here's what it's for.
  
  

* Tech screening round — 30 minutes.
* Take-home — a small orchestrated LLM system. Using AI is expected; being unable to defend what it wrote is disqualifying.
* Interview round 1 — we walk through your submission and argue about it.
* Interview round 2 - Technical + Managerial

**Baner, Pune.**
Health cover, team offsites, and a culture that's flexible in the ways that matter rather than the ways that photograph well.

title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
   

  

**For Internal Applicants**
* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP)
* L09 Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L09\+ Employees can apply

* Experience in performance testing of AI models, including evaluation for hallucinations, toxicity, bias, robustness, adversarial attacks, and cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices, ensuring fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI model development and deployment.
* Demonstrate ability to learn and apply new concepts, specifically in the area of financial risk management.
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Relevant certifications in AI/RAI from GARP/ Quantitative courses such as CQF.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions
* Willingness to travel based on client needs.


**What We Offer You**

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Our teams coordinate their time in Centers of Energy to reflect how they work best.

**What You'll Do:**
 LogicMonitor® is the AI\-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. title: Manager Engineering
description:
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud\-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.
   

  

 Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co\-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.
   

  

 Learn more at: https://www.armor.com
   

  

**Summary**
 The Manager, Engineering reports to the Director, Engineering and leads a team of software engineers who build and sustain the products Armor’s customers depend on. This is a hands\-on leadership position: the manager writes production code, opens and reviews pull requests, and ships alongside the engineers they lead. The role exercises independent judgment and discretion in setting technical direction, making architecture decisions, prioritizing defects and feature work, directing incident response, and developing engineering talent. Armor is looking for a technical leader with a track record of building and shipping high\-quality software with AI\-assisted development tools, and with the engineering judgment to raise the bar on architecture, delivery speed, and engineering ownership. This is a full\-time in\-office role based in Pune, India; on\-site presence five days a week is required.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)**
* Lead and manage a high\-performing AI\-native software engineering team, providing technical direction, mentorship, and hands\-on guidance while building a culture of engineering ownership.
* Contribute directly to architecture, design, code reviews, and implementation of complex software, working in the repository alongside the team rather than reviewing from a distance.
* Own day\-to\-day delivery for the assigned product areas, including feature work, defect triage, regression prevention, and customer escalations, and keep the Director, Engineering current on status and risk.
* Drive end\-to\-end engineering execution with minimal reliance on product management, translating business objectives into working software.
* Execute release management discipline set by the Director, Engineering, including change windows, rollback criteria, and release readiness for the team’s work.
* Put AI\-assisted development tools into daily engineering practice, measure the effect on delivery speed and quality, and hold the team to production\-grade standards for AI\-generated code.
* Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, foundation models, developer tools, and cloud technologies, balancing rapid experimentation against production\-grade engineering discipline.
* Hire and build the team, including defining the technical hiring bar, running interview loops, and onboarding new engineers.
* Manage relationships with third\-party technology vendors by evaluating platform usage, monitoring cost and performance, assessing alternatives, and providing technical recommendations that support renewals, negotiations, and build\-versus\-buy decisions.
* Collaborate with global and regional teams, ensuring clear communication, knowledge sharing, and alignment across distributed engineering teams.
* Manage team performance through regular one\-on\-one meetings, goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and career development planning.
* Serve as the escalation point for production incidents and customer\-impacting issues, coordinating rapid response, running post\-incident reviews, and feeding the findings back into engineering practice.


**Required Skills**
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production software that customers depend on. Show us the work; we do not screen on years on a resume.
* Experience leading or managing software engineers, including performance management, coaching, and career development.
* Hands\-on production experience delivering software with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent.
* Strong frontend and backend development skills using technologies such as React, TypeScript, C\#, Node.js, Python, or Go, with demonstrated ability to contribute directly to code, architecture, and technical problem\-solving.
* Excellent software architecture skills, with the ability to set architectural direction, establish engineering standards, and promote practices that improve security, quality, maintainability, and scalability.
* Production experience with AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform, including deploying and operating applications in cloud environments.
* Proven ability to combine hands\-on development with leadership responsibilities without sacrificing either.
* Strong defect management and quality engineering instincts, including the ability to distinguish a regression from a customer\-found defect from a product gap, and to treat each one differently.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes for scalable application delivery.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Strong experience with relational, non\-relational, and AI\-enabled data platforms, including SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases, data modeling, performance tuning, and scalable data architectures for AI applications.
* Experience in a customer\-facing role, providing both technical advice and strategic direction to help customers reach their goals.
* Git proficiency including branching strategies, code review workflows, and CI/CD pipeline integration.
* Understanding of AI/LLM security risks including prompt injection, data leakage, and model limitations.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated output for accuracy and security implications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across distributed teams and time zones.
* Preferred: bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.
* Preferred: experience with virtualization, infrastructure, and data protection technologies such as VMware vSphere, Proxmox, NSX\-T, FortiMonitor, Zerto, and Rubrik.
* Preferred: cybersecurity background covering XDR, MDR, SIEM, SOC tooling, endpoint detection and response, threat detection, incident response, and security monitoring.


**WHY ARMOR**
 Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role – we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story.
   

  

**ARMOR CORE VALUES**
* Commitment to Growth: A growth mindset that encourages continuous learning and improvement with adaptability in the face of challenges.
* Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency \+ honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances.
* Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion and support to the needs of others through genuine connection.
* Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes.
* Follow\-Through: Dedication to delivering finished results with attention to quality and detail to achieve the desired outcomes.


**WORK ENVIRONMENT**
 The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. The work environment can be either in an office setting or remotely from anywhere.
   

  

**Equal opportunity employer** 
 \- it is the policy of the company to comply with all employment laws and to afford equal employment opportunity to individuals in all aspects of employment, including in selection for job opportunities, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws.

**Prerequisites**

**Experience**

title: AI/ML Engineer I
description:
**Job description** 




  





 Job Role \-
 **AI/ML Engineer I** 




 Job Type:
 **Full\-Time** 




 Mode:
 **WFO \- Onsite** 




 Location:
 **Pune** 




 Notice Period:
 **Immediate (preferred) to 30 days** 




 Experience:
 **01 to 03 yrs** 




  





**Most engineers with a year of AI experience have trained models. Few have kept one alive in production. We're hiring for the second kind.** 




  





 Plenty of places will let you fine\-tune a model on a clean dataset, report an accuracy number and call it done. We'd rather hand you a real client problem, a senior engineer who will tell you honestly when your approach won't hold up, and enough rope to own a scoped piece of the system end to end.
 



 If you want the next year to be about production judgement rather than another notebook, this is the right place for it.
   




 About Kreeda Labs
 
 We are an AI and full stack product engineering company based in Pune. We have delivered 75\+ production systems for 40\+ clients across three continents, spanning fashion, HR tech, healthcare, insurance, eLearning and supply chain.
 



 Our work includes engagements with Ralph Lauren, Tata Group / Tata Play, Patanjali and Multiversity. AI is not a side experiment here — it is what a growing share of our client work is built on, and this role works on it directly.
   




 What you'll do
 
 You will work alongside senior engineers on live client systems, not sandboxed exercises — starting with well\-scoped pieces and taking on more as you prove you can carry them.
 



  





**Build** 





 •   
 
 Build and train ML/DL models for real client use cases, from data preparation through evaluation
 




 •   
 
 Build Computer Vision pipelines, including image preprocessing and object detection
 




 •   
 
 Prototype GenAI and RAG applications, including vector database integrations
 



  





**Ship** 





 •   
 
 Build production inference pipelines and REST APIs (FastAPI) around your models
 




 •   
 
 Deploy and maintain AI applications on AWS using Docker
 




 •   
 
 Debug and stabilise deployed models under real traffic, not just in a notebook
 



  





**Research and improve** 





 •   
 
 Fine\-tune open\-source models and compare approaches, including PEFT/LoRA
 




 •   
 
 Read papers, documentation and open\-source repos, and turn promising ideas into working prototypes
 




 •   
 
 Evaluate models and systems properly, and use failure cases to improve them
   




 Who can apply
 
  





**Must have** 





 •   
 
 Approximately 1 year of hands\-on engineering experience, including real AI/ML systems
 




 •   
 
 Strong Python, with scikit\-learn and PyTorch and/or TensorFlow
 




 •   
 
 Practical experience building, training and evaluating ML/DL models, including data preprocessing and feature engineering
 




 •   
 
 Computer Vision fundamentals: OpenCV/PIL, image preprocessing and object detection (YOLO or similar)
 




 •   
 
 Hands\-on GenAI work: prompt engineering, Hugging Face/Transformers, RAG and vector databases
 




 •   
 
 Fine\-tuning experience with open\-source models, including PEFT/LoRA familiarity
 




 •   
 
 Agent and tool\-calling experience with LangChain, LangGraph or an equivalent framework
 




 •   
 
 Backend and API development with FastAPI, plus Pydantic/request validation
 




 •   
 
 Cloud deployment experience with Docker, AWS S3 and AWS EC2
 




 •   
 
 Ability to evaluate models with the right metrics and explain what a failure case taught you
 




 •   
 
 The ability to explain your own architecture and model choices without hiding behind jargon
 



  





**Good to have** 





 •   
 
 MLOps tooling: MLflow, CI/CD, Kubernetes
 




 •   
 
 AWS ECR / ECS / CloudWatch
 




 •   
 
 Multimodal or Vision\-Language Models, advanced model optimisation or quantisation
 



*You don't need every line here. What matters is that you can point to at least one AI/ML project you personally took into production — not just trained.*



 What makes this different
 
 At most companies, a year into an AI role you are still working in one corner of one product, off someone else's spec. Here you will touch real client systems across industries within your first year — the fastest way to build the production judgement that separates an AI/ML engineer from someone who can only train models.
 



 You will also work in an engineering environment where AI\-assisted development is normal. We expect you to use those tools well and still be able to review and defend everything that ends up in the repository.
   




 What you'll gain
 

 •   
 
 Hands\-on ownership of scoped AI/ML components inside real client systems, not sandboxed exercises
 




 •   
 
 Exposure to production GenAI, Computer Vision and classical ML work across industries, not one product
 




 •   
 
 Direct mentorship from senior engineers who will tell you honestly when your approach won't hold up
 




 •   
 
 A clear, merit\-based path toward Senior AI Engineer, defined by what you ship and fix
 




 •   
 
 Compensation that reflects hands\-on production experience, not just a generic entry\-level band
   




 This role may not be for you if
 
 You want to stay in notebooks and hand off anything that touches production, you are only comfortable with clean tutorial datasets, you expect to be told exactly what to build rather than figuring it out, or you have not yet shipped anything a real user depended on.
 



  





*We aim to close the process within two weeks and we respond either way.*

title: Hands-on AI Lead - Cyber Security Startup - CTC INR 75 L
description:
**About the Company and the Role:** 




  





 We are looking for an AI Team Lead to own the machine learning and agentic AI layer of our platform and lead the team building it. You will set the technical direction, lead a team of AI and ML engineers, and stay hands\-on in the code. This is a player\-coach role, not a management\-only one. The role spans both halves of the problem. Classical machine learning does the ranking, classification and behavioural baselining that decides what deserves attention; LLM\-driven agents do the reasoning and investigation on top. You need genuine depth in both, and judgement about which one a given problem actually calls for. Ownership here is real. You decide which models run where and why, you run the R\&D that answers that question, you own local and self\-hosted deployment for customers with private\-cloud or sovereign constraints, and you own how inference cost, latency and quality hold up as the product scales.
 



  





**Required Skills** 



* 8\+ years in machine learning, applied AI or data science, with at least 4 years deploying and owning production systems.
* 2\+ years leading or tech\-leading an AI/ML team while remaining hands\-on. You have set direction, reviewed others' work, and shipped your own.
* You have owned ML and agentic AI workflows in production — chose the approach, shipped it, and stayed accountable for how it behaved. Research and prototypes are not the same thing.
* Strong knowledge of machine learning algorithms for classification, ranking, clustering and anomaly detection on structured and semi\-structured data such aslogs, alerts, identity and cloud events.
* Strong LLM application engineering: retrieval\-augmented generation and grounding, agent orchestration and tool use, structured output, prompt engineering, and fine\-tuning or domain adaptation.
* Hands\-on with local and self\-hosted models (vLLM, TGI, Ollama or equivalent):quantisation, GPU and hardware sizing, and the throughput, latency and cost trade\-offs that come with them.
* Experience building evaluation harnesses — you have measured whether a model, prompt or agent change actually made things better, and can explain how you knew.
* Strong Python with PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit\-learn; proficiency in SQL; and familiarity with LLM frameworks and APIs (OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* MLOps in production — CI/CD for ML, versioning, monitoring and observability — on AWS, GCP or Azure with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working in a startup environment with high ownership.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Nice to have
* Security\-specific ML: UEBA, entity behaviour baselining, graph analytics.
* Working knowledge of security operations and MITRE ATT\&CK or ATLAS.
* Experience with multi\-tenant, private\-cloud or air\-gapped deployment and the isolation constraints that come with it.
* Feedback\-driven systems where analyst input improves future predictions.
* Publications, patents or open\-source contributions in ML/AI.



  





 If this excites you, please share your resume to rajeshwari.vh@careerxperts.com
